# What's new in v1.16.0

## Shiny new things

- Two-factor authentication setup now has a "Copy setup key" button for authenticator apps that can't scan the QR code

## Improvements

- Smoother timeline, sidebar, reader and AI chat: fewer re-renders while answers stream, entries update or the selection changes, and the search index is built only when search opens
- Much better keyboard and screen reader support: icon-only buttons, switches and window controls are named, and menus, pickers, the update notice and shortcut recording work from the keyboard
- Clearer errors: the server's validation errors show under the field they concern, invalid handles, list titles, category names and regex patterns are explained, and a timeline, sidebar or entry that fails to load offers a retry
- Follow, inbox and action forms ask before closing with unsaved changes, and deleting a custom AI shortcut or integration asks first
- The window reopens on the display it was on, maximized if it was
- Typing a website address into Discover lists the site's feeds, and a new feed address opens its preview
- The entry list follows your Date Format setting
- Features that need a paid plan, such as hiding a list from the timeline, following a list privately, BYOK and AI tasks, are now labeled and offer an upgrade
- Exported files are named after Folo, such as folo.opml

## No longer broken

- Fixed timelines opened from Discover, the AI page and other pages showing the wrong view with an empty header and never marking entries read on scroll
- Fixed the last entries of a timeline staying unread after scrolling to the end, and hover mark-as-read firing after the pointer had left the entry
- Fixed folo:// links that launch the app being dropped, so following a feed or signing in from the browser did nothing
- Fixed the app not coming back after installing an update on Windows and Linux
- Fixed the app restarting signed out with default settings after a renderer update, and renderer updates never applying on Linux
- Fixed Check for Updates in the app and tray menus doing nothing when there was no update or the check failed
- Fixed the app running without a window when startup cleanup failed, for example when antivirus held an old file on Windows
- Fixed the HTTP cache limit deleting the newest files first and blocking the app while it ran
- Fixed setting changes made while settings were syncing never being sent, and AI settings being uploaded on every launch, which overwrote AI changes made on other devices
- Fixed your session being written to the Folo CLI config on every launch even if you never connected the CLI
- Fixed custom integration secrets and cookies being written to the log file
- Fixed Cmd+F filling the find bar with the clipboard; it now starts with the previous search
- Fixed AI replies that stopped arriving staying on "Thinking..." forever, stopped replies that couldn't be copied, and failed uploads being sent with the message
- Fixed the text-to-speech shortcut in an open article, playing an entry again after its speech ended, and pausing while the rest was still downloading
- Fixed the profile form refusing to save with a short display name, an empty handle or a handle saved by an older version
- Fixed an unverified email change being reported as done, and a failed account deletion signing you out
- Fixed undo after unfollowing a list, and undo losing the custom title of a feed
- Fixed sidebar lists and inboxes opening in the wrong view, and inboxes missing from the All view
- Fixed alphabetical sorting of subscriptions running in the opposite direction
- Fixed a subscribed feed opened by its link showing as a preview with a Follow banner
- Fixed a failed request replacing a cached entry with "Entry not found"
- Fixed the Zotero and qBittorrent integrations ignoring changed settings until a restart, and Obsidian notes for titles like "Q: ..." never showing up on Windows
- Fixed the image preview giving up instead of trying every image source

TauricResearch/TradingAgents:
Decisions are scored only on final closes and settle across long market holidays, a model's unpadded date no longer reads filings made after the run date, and fixes to portfolios, prices, SEC statements, reports, Azure and Claude settings.

## Upgrading from 0.7.0

- Docker images no longer include `.env.enterprise`. For Azure OpenAI in Docker, put its keys in `.env`.

## Fixed

- A date a model passes without zero padding, such as `2024-7-5`, is read as that date. It could compare as later than a filing made after the run date, and SEC EDGAR then served that filing. (#1488)
- A decision is no longer scored on the bar of a session still trading, and one made before a market closure longer than a week, such as a national holiday, settles once trading resumes instead of staying pending. (#1548, #1539)
- A backtest reports the failures of its last settlement pass, and two started in the same second no longer share one run. (#1557, #1549)
- A holding listed under a broker's spelling (`BTCUSDT`, `700.HK`) is matched to the instrument analyzed, and a portfolio number that is not finite is refused when the file loads. (#1556, #1509)
- Prices keep their significant digits: a sub-cent close no longer prints as 0.00, and a currency pair keeps its pips. (#1567)
- SEC EDGAR statements list one row per period, so a model no longer reads a figure against the wrong quarter across a long history, and a figure under one million no longer prints as 0. (#1517, #1589)
- Saving a report to a folder used before removes the earlier run's sections. (#1566)
- A date window that ends before it starts is sent back to the model instead of returning no data. (#1595)
- A statement frequency other than annual or quarterly is sent back to the model instead of being served annual figures under that word. (#1593)
- The memory's most recent lessons, and the entries rotation keeps, follow decision dates, so a backfill of older dates no longer displaces them. (#1603)
- Prediction-market odds near 0% or 100% show their distance from it to two significant digits. (#1598)
- Azure OpenAI receives `max_tokens` and a configured endpoint. (#1584, #1600)
- Claude's effort setting is decided correctly for dated model IDs such as `claude-sonnet-4-20250514`. (#1585)
- The CLI checks a ticker with the same rule as the run, so `XAUUSD+` is accepted and `..` is refused at the prompt. (#1604)
- Docker images no longer include `.env` files from any folder.
- Tests that failed on Windows and macOS for platform reasons are fixed. (#1506, #1485, #1541)

TecharoHQ/anubis:
This is mostly for the eMudhra debacle (CVE-2026-111943).

## Features

- Add Catalan (ca) localization.
- Allow Renovate in git clients for github/gitlab api endpoint.

### Fixed

- Add `utils/cmd/botgenerate` for automatically updating crawler IP ranges. Also apply the updates.
- Do not reject with `400 Bad Request` a request whose `Content-Type` is `multipart/form-data` but whose body is empty, including when the content length is unknown (`-1`, for example a chunked request). Reverse proxies that strip the body for auth subrequests (for example nginx' `auth_request`) still forward the original `Content-Type`, which made `prepareChallengeForm` fail and answer with a spurious 400.
- Reject requests with no `User-Agent` header or an empty `User-Agent` header via `(data)/bots/spec-violations.yaml`.
- Accept GeoIP2 ISP databases for ASN lookups and GeoLite2 City databases for country lookups.
- Fix concurrent WASM challenge validation failures by instantiating transient modules anonymously, allowing the existing four-slot verifier concurrency limit to work as intended.

## 重点概览

- 新增原生 batch 推理基础设施，Mat/VkMat、CPU/Vulkan 调度、C/Python 接口和 pnnx 转换同步扩展；Reshape 支持 batch 与普通维度之间的重组，进一步完善动态 reshape、flatten、unflatten 的 batch 语义。（@futz12）
- Vulkan 后端新增 Convolution、ConvolutionDepthWise、InnerProduct、GEMM 的 int8 推理路径，配套 integer dot product、cooperative matrix、Winograd 和 int8 packing，量化模型不再因存在 int8 层而整体关闭 GPU。
- 新增面向 LLM 的 int4/int6/int8 块量化、`ncnnllm2table` / `ncnnllm2int` 工具和五大 CPU 后端的 int8 块量化优化，并引入会话级 KV cache allocator、容量复用及 bf16 模型权重存储。
- x86 后端新增 fp32/bf16 SDPA FlashAttention prefill/decode，扩展 AVX2、AVX-NE-CONVERT、FMA/FMA4 dispatch，并补齐 CumulativeSum、Reduction、Normalize、Permute 的 SIMD 实现。（@crafcat7）
- RISC-V 补齐 packed int8 Convolution、im2col GEMM、Winograd、SDPA/MultiHeadAttention，继续优化 fp16 GEMM 和常见激活，并新增 BF16 能力检测及 Cast/Clip 转换路径。（@Deepdive543443, @futz12, @darkavatar23）
- Vulkan LayerNorm、RMSNorm、GroupNorm、InstanceNorm 新增 subgroup 归约，cooperative matrix 继续优化访存、对齐和 Adreno 兼容；同步修复 bf16 舍入、归一化系数精度及 Tanh/GELU 大输入溢出问题。（@futz12）
- 模型、参数与图加载增加系统性校验，新增默认开启的 `NCNN_VALIDATION`，修复负数索引、长度/数值溢出、非法层参数、循环图、截断 mmap 权重及失败加载后的资源清理问题。（@aleff-github, @professor-moody, @beilzx, @kaltsit-10, @ktz03, @Dr3ladwyn, @FluxMind-O, @lxcxjxhx）
- pnnx 完善 MelSpectrogram、多前导维度 Linear、全局池化布局、ONNX fp16/bool 常量和 Transformer attention 融合，修复插值与动态 batch 转换，CI 测试矩阵扩展至 PyTorch 2.14。（@futz12, @Lfan-ke, @ktz03, @giuliocorradi, @Acture, @xy200303）
- 发布流程新增 Ubuntu 26.04、VS2026、wasm64 和 Android/iOS Python wheel，WebAssembly 更新至 Emscripten 6.0.12 并使用原生 LLVM OpenMP；Python 的 OpenCV 依赖改为可选项。

## Vulkan / GPU

- 新增 Vulkan Convolution、ConvolutionDepthWise、InnerProduct、GEMM 的 int8 推理，覆盖普通卷积、depthwise/group convolution、全连接和动态矩阵量化；Net 加载量化模型时保留 Vulkan 执行能力。
- int8 Convolution 补齐 direct、1x1s1d1、GEMM、Winograd F(2,3)/F(4,3) 路径，GEMM/卷积可按设备能力使用 packed integer dot product 和 signed int8 cooperative matrix，并保留普通整数 shader 路径。
- Padding、Flatten、Packing、Quantize、Requantize 补齐 Vulkan int8 数据处理，Winograd 中间数据增加 int16 packed/storage 布局；新增 `use_int16_packed` / `use_int16_storage` 选项和 C API，`use_int8_arithmetic` 默认开启并按设备能力过滤。
- 新增 Vulkan Tile，支持 pack1/pack4、axis/tiles 和 repeats 模式，维度提升时先以 pack1 完成 gather，再转换为目标 packing，减少重复张量操作的 CPU fallback。（@losewayy）
- LayerNorm、RMSNorm 新增 subgroup 归约，在一次统计 dispatch 中完成均值/方差或平方和计算，减少多轮中间归约；支持 pack1/pack4、FP32 统计和跨 subgroup 合并，缺少 subgroup arithmetic 时保留原有路径，并跳过未使用的 fallback pipeline 创建。（@futz12）
- GroupNorm、InstanceNorm 新增 subgroup 归约，采用中心化与补偿 FP32 累加改善长序列和大离群值场景的均值/方差精度；同时处理 packed group 边界、cstep 和跨 subgroup 合并，并拆分 group/channel 调度以避免 dispatch 数量超限。（@futz12）
- LayerNorm、RMSNorm 的归一化系数改用 FP32 workspace，归一化及 affine 运算也在 FP32 中完成后再转换为目标 storage，减少 fp16/bf16 路径的系数舍入误差。（@futz12）
- MultiHeadAttention、SDPA 的 Vulkan KV cache 改用后端私有布局，新增 copy/append shader；配置专用 `kvcache_vkallocator` 时可预留序列容量、原位追加并按需扩容，使 cache 在多个 Extractor 之间持续驻留 GPU。
- 重新启用支持相应扩展的 Adreno cooperative matrix 路径，GEMM、Convolution、Convolution1D、Deconvolution、SDPA 根据 shared memory、workgroup 和 subgroup 限制收缩 tile unroll，资源不足时回退；增加静态矩阵布局分支、GEMM pack1/pack4 输出 pipeline 和 int8 unroll 限制。
- 在满足 Vulkan 1.3 / maintenance4 条件时使用 SPIR-V 1.6 和 `LocalSizeId`，修正 workgroup size specialization 注入与反射，规避 Adreno subgroup shuffle 编译问题；pipeline cache 格式版本同步更新。
- 修复 GEMM、int8 Convolution、SDPA/FlashAttention cooperative matrix load/store 的行步长对齐；AMD 原生 bf16 转换前增加显式舍入，使其与 bf16 packed 软件路径保持一致，规避驱动 RTZ 转换带来的精度差异。
- 修复 Adreno 上 GEMM 普通/subgroup 路径的 fp16 packed bias 读取和 SDPA mask 读取，先计算完整元素索引，避免奇数行步长下的 packed-half 地址错误。
- 优化 GEMM、SDPA cooperative matrix shader，移除浮点路径的 shared memory padding 并重新计算资源需求；GEMM pack4 加载改用交错 K 索引，改善展开 tile 的访存顺序。
- Adreno 的 int8 Convolution cooperative matrix 路径取消 shared memory 行 padding，同步调整权重打包与资源估算，并为 Winograd 预留 2 KiB 驱动共享内存开销；修复 1x1 和 im2col 路径中的边界判断及强制循环展开问题，避免输出错误或漏写。
- 修复 Adreno 的 packed int16 解码和 Winograd F(4,3) 输出边界分支，解决部分驱动下高 16 位取值错误及输出漏写问题。
- 新增 `VK_EXT_cooperative_matrix_maintenance1` 和 `VK_EXT_shader_ocp_microscaling_types` 的扩展/feature 查询，cooperative matrix tile 选择纳入按 subgroup size 枚举的 Properties2 结果，并补齐旧 Vulkan 头文件兼容定义。
- Apple Silicon 纳入优先使用 shader local memory 的设备范围，Net 通过新的 `GpuInfo::prefer_shader_local_memory()` 保留适用的 local-memory 优化。
- 适配 Vulkan over WebGPU/OpenCL，Emscripten 的 simplevk 支持静态 Vulkan bootstrap；设备初始化增加 storage image 支持查询，在不支持时跳过 dummy image、sampler 和相关 image 测试。
- simplevk 在适用的系统、厂商及 MoltenVK 驱动库加载路径均失败后，尝试加载 `momoten.dll` / `libmomoten.dylib` / `libmomoten.so`，为已安装 momoten 的设备提供额外驱动入口。
- Vulkan 下载增加 `HOST_CACHED` 判断，可映射但未缓存的 blob memory 改经 staging buffer 读取；贡献者在 Radeon 8060S / RADV 的 128 MB 下载测试中报告带宽由 0.32 GB/s 提升至 4.19 GB/s。（@giuliocorradi）
- VkTransfer 的 compute/transfer command pool 增加 command-buffer reset 标志，使逐层权重上传过程中的 reset 满足 Vulkan 约定。
- 完善 subgroup 能力过滤，GEMM/SDPA 检查所需功能位，fp16 subgroup 路径要求 `shaderSubgroupExtendedTypes`；小 subgroup 设备的激活、Packing、量化等层同步调整候选 local size。
- Vulkan 创建管线时同时检查 subgroup size control 与 `requiredSubgroupSizeStages` 的 compute 位，避免为不支持的计算阶段指定 subgroup size；`VkWeightAllocator` 补齐 `TRANSFER_SRC` 用途，使 MemoryData 权重 buffer 可作为 `vkCmdCopyBuffer` 的源，修复 MoltenVK 上发现的两处校验错误。（@kongxinjun）
- GLSL 公共类型、buffer 访问和精度转换宏集中到 `ncnn_glsl_ext.comp`，修复缺少 shaderInt64 时的 fp16 shader 编译，以及缺少 shaderInt16 时的 bf16 packed 编译和 packing；ERF、CELU 修正 fp16 arithmetic 向量常量类型。（@aadpnde, @futz12）
- Reduction 修复 shared accumulator 精度和小 subgroup 多阶段归约的 shared memory 读写，4D depth stride 改按 `w*h` 寻址，避免 channel padding 干扰。
- 修复 Vulkan Tanh/GELU 大输入在部分驱动上的溢出；UnaryOp round 改用 `roundEven`，修复 MoltenVK 半整数舍入与 CPU 不一致的问题。（@kongxinjun）
- 为 llvmpipe/v3dv 的 packed BinaryOp 补齐 `atan2(0,0)` workaround，并修复 descriptor pool 的零计数项和 sampler 数量统计，改善严格 Vulkan 驱动上的兼容性。（@LEKKO2310, @ktz03）
- 修复 Deconvolution/DeconvolutionDepthWise 输出裁剪参数 buffer 过小导致的越界写；BinaryOp 的广播 shape hint 比较纳入 elempack，避免物理尺寸相同但 packing 不同的输入选错 pipeline。（@ktz03）
- 修复 Vulkan/CPU 混合执行时空 optional input 的传输判断，初次 decode 的空 KV cache 可正确进入 fallback 层；MultiHeadAttention 同步修正 3D mask 的 pack1 转换、cstep 和 query 行寻址。（@futz12）
- Shader 编译诊断与 `#version` 解析改为按显式源码长度扫描，修复无结尾 NUL 的 shader buffer 越界读取和诊断乱码，并新增回归测试。（@lazypool, @marcin-sochacki）

## x86 CPU 后端

- SDPA 新增专用 FlashAttention prefill/decode，覆盖 fp32/bf16 storage、GQA、attention mask 和 KV cache，通过分块计算、online softmax、向量化矩阵乘及 packed cache 复用，减少完整 attention score 中间张量和 decode 重复打包。
- 重构 FMA dispatch，新增 FMA4 编译/运行时检测和 `NCNN_FMA4` 选项；卷积、GEMM、InnerProduct、SDPA、归一化、激活、逐元素、GridSample、ROIAlign、LSTM 等共享 kernel 并使用独立 FMA/FMA4 调度。
- AVX512BF16 使用 `vcvtne2ps2bf16` 合并转换，AVX2/AVX512 优化 bf16 到 fp32 的扩展，并为更多 bf16 层增加 AVX2 dispatch。
- 新增 AVX-NE-CONVERT bf16 GEMM、加载/广播/转换优化，扩展到卷积、InnerProduct、Deconvolution、Pooling、Interp、SDPA、归一化、激活和逐元素等路径，减少相应 CPU 上的 bf16 转换开销。
- GEMM int8 块量化新增 SSE/AVX2、XOP、AVX-VNNI、AVX-VNNI-INT8、AVX512-VNNI 等优化，覆盖动态激活量化、权重预打包、逐块 descale 和 bf16 storage；MultiHeadAttention 的 q/k/v/out projection 复用持久化 GEMM pipeline。
- 新增 CumulativeSum SIMD，实现 SSE/AVX/AVX2/AVX512 前缀扫描和外轴向量累加，覆盖 1D 至 4D 的全部有效 axis，并补齐尾块及运行时/固定 ISA 调度。（@crafcat7）
- 新增 Reduction x86 实现，覆盖 fp32 pack1 的 SUM、ASUM、SUMSQ、MEAN、MAX、MIN、PROD、L1、L2、LogSum、LogSumExp，支持 1D 至 4D 连续/跨步和多轴归约，并加入 FMA/FMA4 调度。（@crafcat7）
- Normalize 新增 packed SIMD，支持 pack1/4/8/16、跨空间/跨通道组合和各 `eps_mode`；SIMD 宽度与输入 packing 分离，并细化 rsqrt/reciprocal 计算。（@crafcat7）
- Permute 新增原生 packed SIMD，直接处理 fp32/fp16/bf16 的 pack1/4/8/16 数据，覆盖 2D/3D/4D 排列、矩形尾块和跨步 transpose，保留 16-bit storage 与特殊浮点位模式。（@crafcat7）
- 优化非重叠 Deconvolution Col2im：在 dilation=1、stride 等于 kernel 大小的矩形核场景，pack1/4/8 直接写出输入贡献和 bias，并对少输出通道场景增加行并行，减少输出预填充和反复读改写。（@Hosi121）
- LayerNorm/RMSNorm 的 fp32/bf16 rsqrt 增加两次 Newton–Raphson 细化，UnaryOp rsqrt 增加一次细化，并收紧归一化测试精度要求。（@futz12）
- 修复旧 GCC 缺少 `_mm512_set_epi16`、VS2017 的 AVX512 abs / bf16 masked load 误编译、块量化 GEMM 非法指令及 MinGW 的 `atan2` 栈对齐问题；AVX512 int8/bf16 打包改用显式窄化 `storeu` intrinsic，改善新旧编译器兼容性。

## ARM CPU 后端

- 新增 RotaryEmbed NEON，实现 interleaved/non-interleaved 布局及 fp32/fp16/bf16 storage；fp16 storage 可保持 FP32 运算，满足 asimdhp 与 arithmetic 选项时使用 fp16 向量算术，16-bit 读取/写回扩展为 8-lane。（@devin-lai）
- GEMM int8 块量化增加 NEON、dotprod 和 i8mm 优化，支持 fp32/fp16/bf16 storage，MultiHeadAttention 的 q/k/v/out projection 同步复用优化 GEMM。
- 重新拟合 fp16 tanh 近似系数，大输入显式饱和到 ±1 并限制区间内过冲，修复原先约 ±1.044 的饱和值及其导致的 fast GELU 大负输入错误。（@LintonCode）
- 调整 fp16 标准/fast GELU 的乘法顺序，避免有限半精度输入因中间 `2*x` 溢出产生 inf，并补充极值、signed zero 和 SIMD 尾块测试。（@ktz03）
- 修复 int8 Convolution 的 fp16 输出预分配 packing，使其与实际反量化结果一致。（@Deepdive543443）
- 增加 Apple A19/A19 Pro、M5 系列、A20 Pro 和 M6 的 CPU family 定义及特征识别分支。

## RISC-V / MIPS / LoongArch 后端

- 重构 RISC-V fp32/fp16 GEMM micro-kernel、打包和调度，区分 fp16 storage + FP32 累加与 fp16 arithmetic 路径，并继续优化 int8 块量化 GEMM。
- RISC-V 新增 fp32 storage 的 SDPA 后端并完善 MultiHeadAttention，复用 GEMM + Softmax，覆盖 mask、GQA、KV cache 和量化 projection。
- RISC-V 新增 RVV 1.0 packed int8 Convolution，使用双位置展开和 packed 权重；同步优化 packed fp16 Dequantize/Requantize，修复输出转换、packing 预分配及分配失败处理。（@Deepdive543443）
- RISC-V 新增 int8 Convolution im2col GEMM，按 L2 cache 与线程数划分 M/N/K tile，包含 1x1 快捷路径、RVV widening accumulation、标量尾块和 XTheadVector 兼容；复用输入 panels 并保留 split-K 部分和。
- RISC-V 新增 int8 Winograd F(2,3)/F(4,3)，采用 int16 输入/权重变换和 int32 widening GEMM，融合输入变换与打包，覆盖空间块尾部、split-K 和 XTheadVector 输出转换。
- RISC-V fp32 packn 5x5s1 Depthwise Convolution 增加四输出行复用，共享输入与权重加载并保持逐输出 FMA 顺序，保留两行/单行尾部处理，减少向量访存。（@luke-opus）
- RISC-V 补齐 ELU、ERF、标准/fast GELU、SELU 的 RVV fp32/fp16 storage，完善标量 fallback，并降低 Erf/标准 GELU 的向量寄存器压力。（@futz12）
- RISC-V 新增 Scale RVV fp32 实现，覆盖 packed 输入、bias 和各维度，并保留无向量扩展时的一维多线程标量路径。（@darkavatar23）
- 修复 RISC-V fp16 tanh 系数下溢及约 ±1.044 的饱和值，改善 TanH、Mish、UnaryOp；fast GELU 同步规避有限 fp16 大输入的中间溢出。（@songxiaoyuwyze, @ktz03）
- 新增 RISC-V BF16 编译/运行时能力检测，分别探测 Zvfbfmin 与 Zvfbfwma；Cast/Clip 提供 scalar、普通 RVV、原生 Zvfbfmin 和 XTheadVector 转换路径，Clip 保持 FP32 运算，XTheadVector 路径保存/恢复 FXCR 模式并保留累计异常标志。
- MIPS MSA、LoongArch LSX/LASX 优化 bf16/int8 GEMM 和 im2col convolution 的转置打包，删除无效分支与重复代码，并增加不同线程数的 int8 GEMM 回归。
- MIPS/LoongArch 新增 int8 块量化 GEMM 的 MSA/LSX/LASX kernel 与 bf16 storage 适配；LayerNorm、RMSNorm、UnaryOp rsqrt 同步增加 Newton–Raphson 细化。（@futz12）
- 修复 MIPS/LoongArch packed8 int8 im2col 的全局 K tile 偏移，并统一修复 SSE2、ARM32 NEON、MSA、LSX int8 Winograd 的 pack8 K tile 对齐。

## 通用算子与模型能力

- Mat/VkMat 增加 `n` / `nstep`、batch 构造和子视图，Net 在 CPU/Vulkan 上调度多 batch，upload/download、cast、packing 和 C API 同步扩展；`NCNN_BATCH` 默认开启。
- Reshape 支持 batch 与普通维度之间的折叠、拆分和重排，表达式可引用 `0n` 等 batch 大小；修复 batch 轴不变但分区变化、独立输入 shape 引用及错误 fast path，CPU 各后端与 Vulkan 同步处理。（@futz12）
- MultiHeadAttention/SDPA 新增会话级 `kvcache_allocator`、`kvcache_vkallocator` 和 `kvcache_max_seqlen_hint`，配合后端私有 cache 布局减少逐 token 分配与历史数据拷贝；C++ Extractor、C API 和 Python 绑定同步扩展。
- Mat 形式的 KV cache 通过 `type=1` 提取并保留底层存储，Vulkan cache 通过 VkMat 提取，均按后端原始布局回灌；当前 KV cache 支持 batch=1，新布局不兼容旧的手工构造或持久化 cache，升级后应从空 cache 开始新会话。
- Convolution 的 1D 输入、1x1 kernel 兼容路径增加弃用提示，建议改用 InnerProduct；相关 benchmark 模型同步使用明确的全连接层表示。
- RotaryEmbed 支持非交错模式的完整宽度 cos/sin cache，两个半区可使用不同频率，修复 2D / vision RoPE 输出；保留半宽 cache，CPU/Vulkan 的 fp32/fp16/bf16 路径同步更新。（@Acture）
- 修复 Interp 非整数 scale factor 的 linear/bilinear/bicubic 采样，保留原始缩放比例并分别钳制短轴采样点，覆盖输出尺寸不变但仍需重采样及长度为 1 的边界，CPU/Vulkan 同步修复。（@Acture, @xy200303）
- 修复 CPU LRN 在偶数 `local_size` 下跨通道多累计一个通道的问题，统一 generic、x86、ARM、MIPS、LoongArch 与现有 Vulkan 的窗口约定。（@ktz03）
- 修复通用 MultiHeadAttention KV history 拷贝越界和持久缓存的分配生命周期问题；单通道 3D mask 可跨 heads 广播，CPU/Vulkan、普通/KV cache 路径及量化校准统计同步修正。（@futz12）
- BF16 转换由截断改为最近值舍入，各 CPU 与 Vulkan packed 路径同步调整；软件 fp32→fp16、fp16→fp8/bf8 转换也改进舍入，pnnx 的 fp16 常量转换保持同步。
- 混合 storage 图按目标元素位宽选择 packing，并调整 repack 与升降精度转换顺序，修复 RISC-V bf16/fp16 输入进入 fp32-only 层时的布局处理。
- 加强 ParamDict 文本/二进制解析，检查负数 ID、数组/字符串长度、整数/浮点边界、畸形数字及引号，补充 getter 类型检查、重载隔离和分配失败处理；`ncnn2mem` 同步解析和失败返回，保留整数标量到 float getter 的数值转换。（@aleff-github, @professor-moody, @beilzx）
- 加强 Net 文本/二进制图加载校验，覆盖 layer/blob 数量、连接索引、shape hint、feature mask、自定义层和连接数；拒绝二进制循环图，并修复失败重载、creator/destroyer 和 CPU 替换路径的资源清理。（@kaltsit-10, @beilzx, @ktz03）
- 多个层补充参数类型、数组长度、维度、卷积核、窗口、operation/mode、激活参数和 Einsum 表达式校验；新增默认开启的 `NCNN_VALIDATION`，已验证的固定模型可关闭附加校验以减小体积。（@beilzx, @FluxMind-O, @lxcxjxhx, @ktz03）
- `DataReaderFromMemory` 新增带长度构造，对 read/reference/scan 实施边界限制；mmap 加载使用有界 reader 并传递实际错误，避免截断或损坏的权重文件在加载途中越界崩溃。（@Dr3ladwyn）
- 统一对齐内存分配/释放的条件分支，修复头文件包含顺序改变 allocator 方案导致的堆损坏；卷积、InnerProduct、Padding、DeconvolutionDepthWise 等补齐空 Mat、OOM 和子层错误传递。（@ktz03）
- 初始化 YoloDetectionOutput 的 softmax 成员，修复仅加载 param 后销毁可能访问未初始化指针的问题；CPU 拓扑或共享 cache 信息不完整时使用有效核数兜底，避免初始化除零/SIGFPE。（@kaltsit-10）
- 运行时与 pnnx 常量表达式的 `logaddexp` 改用稳定计算，避免大数指数溢出，并保留 NaN 和相同正负无穷的处理语义。（@primorLee）
- 修复 GNU/Clang SIMPLEOMP 串行内层 parallel region 返回后未恢复外层 thread ID/team size 的问题，并在 Clang 路径中分离待生效线程数请求与当前 team 状态。

## pnnx / 转换工具

- pnnx 新增原生 batch 布局分析，reshape、permute、slice/select、concat/split、reduce、pooling、norm 等转换同步扩展；生成的 Python 包装使用显式 batch 轴输入并还原输出。
- reshape、reshape_as、flatten、unflatten 与动态 shape 表达式统一按逻辑维度生成参数，修复 batch 折叠/拆分、同轴 batch 大小改变、外部 shape 引用和相邻 reshape 融合。（@futz12）
- 普通 reshape 只在需要时写出 batch 布局参数，改善对旧 ncnn 的兼容；修复 ONNX Flatten 的 axis / 两侧展平转换，以及 batch-aware layer 的独立 shape 输入检查。
- 重新整理全局池化输出布局，在适用逐元素与广播路径中传递紧凑布局，按需恢复输出形状；符合条件的池化后 1x1 Conv2d 转为 Linear，并清理多余广播 Reshape。
- 完善 STFT/Spectrogram reshape 模式识别，支持 `torchaudio.transforms.MelSpectrogram`；通过 batch pack/unpack 保留多前导维度及动态 waveform 长度，补齐 padding、complex/power 输出回归。（@futz12）
- 修复 Linear 多前导维度的展平与恢复，以及 native batch 轴参与 F.pad / spectrogram padding 时的布局转换，覆盖相关 rank-3/4/5 输入。（@futz12）
- ONNX 导入补齐 fp16 标量常量，从 `raw_data` / `int32_data` 位模式读取，修复后续表达式优化缺少常量值的问题；bool 常量按 raw int8 MemoryData 写出并保持字节布局。（@Lfan-ke, @ktz03, @giuliocorradi）
- 补充 ALBERT、CLIP、ProphetNet、Flaubert、XLM attention 融合变体，修复 query/key 长度和 mask shape 匹配，并在消除死代码时保留图输入。
- 插值转换保留 `recompute_scale_factor=True`，为 F.interpolate / nn.Upsample 生成运行时尺寸表达式，避免仅因输入输出 shape 相同而删除仍需重采样的操作。（@Acture, @xy200303）

## 量化与模型写出

- 新增 GEMM/MultiHeadAttention 的 int4/int6/int8 块量化，支持 32/64/128 元素块及可选输入 scale，`NCNN_WEIGHT_QUANT` 默认开启；int4/int6 为权重量化，int8 CPU 路径采用动态逐行/逐块激活量化、int32 点积和逐块反量化累加。
- 新增 `ncnnllm2table` / `ncnnllm2int`，支持 minmax、mseclip、AWQ、GPTQ，生成/消费 GEMM 及 MHA q/k/v/out 的块 scale、输入 scale 和 GPTQ packed qweight；minmax/mseclip 也可直接指定参数量化，AWQ/GPTQ 使用校准 table。
- ModelBin/ModelWriter 补齐 int4/int6/int8 块量化 raw-byte 读写和 4 字节对齐，支持 DataReader reference；MultiHeadAttention 的块量化范围为 q/k/v/out projection，注意力及 KV cache 保持浮点计算/存储。
- `ncnn2table` 新增 `method=percentile`，支持固定分位数及候选分位数自动选择，并将零值纳入激活直方图，覆盖 Convolution、ConvolutionDepthWise、InnerProduct 的输入激活校准。（@Roundaboutt）
- GEMM 静态权重 scale 可由 `ncnn2table` 生成，`ncnn2int8` 优先消费并检查完整性，同时保留旧 table / 未提供 GEMM scale 时的 absmax 回退；修复 B 权重矩阵 absmax 统计遗漏数据。（@Roundaboutt）
- 模型格式新增 bf16 权重标签 `0x01348B83`，ModelBin 支持读取，`ncnnoptimize` 的 `flag=2` 可写出 bf16 权重，并新增 `Mat::from_bfloat16`；ModelWriter 同时修复大端平台相关权重标签及数据的小端写出。
- bool 常量以每元素 1 字节写入 `MemoryData load_type=3`，补齐 4 字节 padding 和 raw int8 加载；ModelWriter/ncnnoptimize 保留其字节表示及 load_type，避免权重错位或按 fp32 错误融合。（@ktz03, @giuliocorradi）

## Benchmark / Perf

- `benchncnn` 开启 GPU int8 benchmark，相关量化模型参数及旧式 Convolution 线性层同步调整。
- `benchncnn_llm` 的 CPU benchmark 为 Hunyuan 0.5B、MiniCPM4 0.5B、Qwen2.5 0.5B、Qwen3 0.6B、Llama3.2 1B、TinyLlama 1.1B、Youtu LLM 2B 增加 int8g32/int8g128 变体；输入、mask、RoPE 构造移出计时范围，按最小耗时报告最高 prefill/decode TPS。
- LLM benchmark 的适用 decoder param 启用 GQA，使用专用 KV cache allocator，Vulkan 侧以 VkMat 保留缓存；默认关闭 fp16 packed/storage/arithmetic，保留 bf16 选项并按设备能力回退。
- 新增/扩展 Reduction、Normalize、Permute、LayerNorm、RMSNorm、GroupNorm、InstanceNorm 和 SDPA KV cache 的算子级 perf，覆盖 SIMD、subgroup 归约及连续 decode 缓存复用。（@crafcat7, @futz12）
- 补充 OOM、batch fp16/bf16 cast、GEMM 多线程、卷积 split-K/packing 和低精度极值回归；精简冗余 GPU 测试组合，调整 fp16 arithmetic / denormal 测试，并修复 SimpleSTL/SimpleMath 测试构建。（@ktz03）

- 新增 Ubuntu 26.04 静态/动态发布包，保留 22.04/24.04；新增 VS2026 v145 + Windows SDK 26100 的 x86/x64/arm64 静态/动态发布包，并为 Windows release 的旧 Protobuf 构建补充 CMake 4 policy 兼容设置。

- WebAssembly 多线程 CI 和发布配置改用 Emscripten 自带 LLVM OpenMP，保留 SimpleOMP 可选；ncnn 与 glslang 等依赖统一启用 pthread，安装目标向应用传递 `-pthread`，允许应用控制 worker pool。
- Python 发布新增 CPython 3.13/3.14/3.15 的 Android API 24+、iOS 14+ CPU wheel，覆盖 Android arm64/x86_64、iOS arm64 设备与 arm64/x86_64 模拟器，Vulkan/OpenMP 关闭；基础 smoke test 在可用模拟器运行，设备架构另做构建和产物校验。

- Python Mat 增加 batch 构造、`batch` 子视图和 `batch_index` NumPy 转换；自定义层工厂改为每个 Net 保存稳定 userdata，移除进程级十槽回调表，修复多 Net、clear/reload 和被替换回调的生命周期。（@ktz03）

## Quivr 2.0.2

2.0.2 moves the search database to Weaviate 1.39.14. It changes no API, no configuration and no stored data. Upgrade any 2.0.x installation to it.

### What Weaviate 1.39.14 fixes for Quivr

- **Filtered searches no longer fail at random.** Quivr filters every vector and hybrid search to the scope of the request. Weaviate's default filtering strategy could crash such a search on a node of the vector graph with more links than expected, and the search then returned an error.
- **Security:** CVE-2026-63209, in the compression library.
- **Less memory.**
  - Quivr compresses its vectors. Compressed indexes now drop the uncompressed vector cache they no longer use, which can save gigabytes on a large index.
  - Weaviate also stops keeping memory it never frees when writing to its in-memory tables.
- **Safer restarts.** A crash right after a shutdown could leave a keyword-search file empty, and the database would then not start without a manual repair. Startup and shutdown are also faster.

Results do not change. The hybrid search changes in 1.39.14 only affect `offset` paging and `nearText` queries, and Quivr uses neither.

### Upgrade from 2.0.0 or 2.0.1

1. Back up the search database volume.
2. Deploy the 2.0.2 images and the new Weaviate pin from `deploy/infrastructure.json`, or the 2.0.2 compose bundle attached to this release for a single machine.
3. Keep the same Weaviate volume.

This is a patch upgrade within one Weaviate minor version: no re-indexing and no Quivr migration. The test that upgrades a 1.37.15 volume through 1.38.20 to 1.39.14, then checks lexical, semantic and hybrid search, passes on this release.

The release images are signed and carry SBOMs, as described in [Security of Quivr releases](https://docs.quivr.thevibecompany.co/run-quivr/security).

# v0.106.1
> [!IMPORTANT]
> This is a security release for the **server and Docker images**. If you run Trilium as a server, especially one reachable from the internet, update as soon as possible.

### 🔒 Security

1.  [Updated Node.js in the Docker images](https://github.com/TriliumNext/Trilium/issues/12223) to 24.22.1 (22.23.4 for the legacy image), taking in the Node.js security releases of 21 October 2026:
    1.  **Brotli decoder out-of-bounds write (CVE-2026-111497).** Trilium decompresses Brotli-encoded request bodies before authentication, so on earlier versions any client that could reach the server could send a malicious request. Outbound requests (link previews, image downloads, web search) were also affected through the responses they receive.
    2.  **Revoked eMudhra/emSign certificate authorities.** The certificate store bundled with Node.js trusted certificate authorities whose keys were compromised. This allowed a man-in-the-middle with the right network access to impersonate HTTPS servers that Trilium connects to (sync with another instance, link previews, LLM providers).
    3.  Other fixes to TLS, HTTP and DNS handling from the same Node.js release.

> [!TIP]
> If you enjoyed this release, consider showing a token of appreciation by:

VectifyAI/PageIndex:
- **Cheaper** than vector RAG: for both index and query.
- **Faster**: trees are created from layout stats.
- **Unified** SDK: vectorless RAG. **Local** or **cloud**, for index and chat.
- Runs on your **Claude subscription**.

Index, to chat, to agent integration, one client.
Local mode needs no server, no vector DB, no PageIndex API key.

```python
client = PageIndexClient()
client.submit_document("report.pdf")
client.chat("What does the report conclude?")
```

## Highlights

- **Flash engine**: the local default (`mode="standard"` keeps the classic LLM pipeline). Embedded bookmarks are consumed when trustworthy, and tree optimization is on by default — `optimize="merge"` for the deterministic LLM-free pass, `"full"` (default) adds LLM expand, which runs a wave of nodes concurrently instead of one round-trip at a time.
- **One complete surface, local and cloud**: `PageIndexLocalClient(storage_path=...)` is the same client as cloud — submit, tree, page content, chat, and agent tools all present in both modes, so code moves between them unchanged.
- **Cloud documents, your own model**: `api_key` decides where your documents live; a configured chat model decides who answers — and the two combine. `PageIndexClient(api_key="pi-...", chat_model="openai/gpt-5.2")` runs the same in-process document-QA engine over the live cloud tool set. Page content flows through your process to your provider on your credentials; `doc_id` targets at the prompt level; `enable_citations` stays with the managed chat.
- **Agent integration**: the cloud MCP tool contract, in-process — `client.agent_tools()` (plain functions), `as_openai_tools()`, `as_anthropic_tools()`, `as_claude_mcp()`, plus one-call `openai_agent_config()` / `anthropic_runner_config()` / `claude_agent_config()` bundles and `agent_instructions()` for the system prompt. Cloud clients get the live server tool set over the MCP bridge (read-only endpoint by default); local clients get the in-process subset with the same schemas and envelopes — agent prompts port unchanged.
- **Chat surfaces**: `chat()` — question in, answer out, on any backend; `chat(stream=True)` shows the run as it happens, thinking and tool calls woven into the text, or as typed events via `.events`; `chat(protocol="responses" | "messages")` drives the OpenAI Responses or Anthropic Messages API natively with that protocol's own shapes, and `chat_completions()` keeps the OpenAI-compatible envelope — all with `doc_id` targeting, streaming, honest usage accounting, and prompt-cache continuity across turns. Transcripts append verbatim: a protocol lane's output goes back into the next request unchanged.
- **Model & connection knobs**: `index_model` / `chat_model`, `index_backend` / `chat_backend` (and per-call `backend`) passed verbatim to each lane — LiteLLM-routed providers, keyless OpenAI-compatible servers, Azure/Bedrock/Vertex included.
- **`index=` / `chat=` slots**: the grouped spelling of the flat arguments — a string shorthand or a mapping (`index={"model": ..., "storage_path": ...}`, `chat={"model": ..., "backend": ...}`). `"cloud"` / `"local"` name a side, an optional `mode=` cross-checks it, and `PageIndexLocalClient` / `PageIndexCloudClient` take the same slots. `PageIndexCloudClient()` reads `PAGEINDEX_API_KEY`; a bare `PageIndexClient()` stays local no matter what the environment holds.
- **Typed config shapes**: `IndexConfig` / `CloudIndexConfig` / `LocalIndexConfig` / `ChatConfig`, with `py.typed` shipped so your type checker sees them.
- **Nothing fails quietly**: unknown keys, mixed sides, empty values and mode/content conflicts refuse at construction with the legal vocabulary in the message; dead credentials or a missing model fail the indexing run instead of storing a document with blank summaries; every cloud error carries its HTTP status.
- **Dependencies**: Python >= 3.10; `openai-agents` in the base install (the chat engine); `[anthropic]` and `[claude]` extras for those SDKs. **Pillow >= 9.0** is now a required dependency for `highlight_region`.

## Also in 0.5.0

- **Reasoning models keep their reasoning.** Every request of a chat run, and every turn after it, sends the model its own reasoning back, on every route: Claude's thinking, `reasoning_content` from Kimi, GLM, Qwen and others, OpenRouter's `reasoning_details`, GPT's reasoning items, Gemini's thought signatures, and Bedrock's encrypted reasoning. Claude through a gateway such as OpenRouter now reads the prompt cache too.
- **`reasoning_effort="none"` turns Claude's thinking off**, in `chat()` and in index summaries, where it is the default (Sonnet 5.5 still thinks between tool calls). On Opus 5.5 and Fable, which can't turn it off, and on any `claude-code/` model, an explicit `"none"` raises, and the summary default runs them at low.
- **Models newer than LiteLLM's model map work**, such as `bedrock/global.openai.gpt-6.1-terra`: where LiteLLM refuses one, PageIndex fetches LiteLLM's published map once and sends again. `LITELLM_LOCAL_MODEL_COST_MAP=True` turns this off.
- **Retries follow the official OpenAI and Anthropic SDKs** on indexing, chat and the cloud API: a rate limit waits the time the server asks, up to 60 s, a missing OpenAI key fails at once, and 402, 413 and 422 are not retried. Flash summaries run 128 at a time, so the summary stage is about a quarter faster on large documents.
- **Claude subscription indexing runs as one Claude Code workflow**, up to 64 summaries at once instead of 16. `PAGEINDEX_CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW=0` goes back to a process per call.
- **Forked workers no longer hang.** A worker forked from a process with a client (`multiprocessing` on Linux, gunicorn `--preload`, Celery) no longer hangs or reads another process's replies.
- **BREAKING: `extra_body` reaches every provider.** Fields only OpenAI takes, such as `store` and `verbosity`, were dropped unseen on Claude and Gemini and now raise; `litellm.drop_params = True` drops them again. `extra_body` refuses `reasoning_effort`, which has its own argument.
- **BREAKING: a cloud read timeout** raises requests' `ConnectionError` after its retries instead of `ReadTimeout`, so `except requests.Timeout` no longer catches it.
- **Gemini history saved without `model`**, as 0.4.5 to 0.4.7 returned it, sends earlier Gemini tool calls without their own thought signature. History saved with `model` keeps them.

Also in 0.4.7:

- **Read and change a folder's metadata fields.** `get_metadata_schema(folder_id)` returns the fields that apply to a folder's documents (its top-level folder's, else the account's), and `delete_metadata_schema(folder_id)` removes the ones the folder declares, so they can be declared again with `create_metadata_schema()`. Documents keep their metadata. Cloud only.

Also in 0.4.6:

- **The Messages lane works with anthropic 2.2.** anthropic 2.2.0 runs its tool runner on a server-held thread by default, so behind a proxy such as OpenRouter's Anthropic endpoint the second model call failed, and the returned `messages` repeated the final reply. `chat(protocol="messages")` now sends the whole conversation on every turn, as with earlier anthropic releases, and `messages` carries each turn once.

Also in 0.4.5:

- **Multi-turn chat keeps the prompt cache.** With an API chat model, `chat_completions()` and `chat(protocol="chat_completions")` return the run's new messages (tool calls, tool results, the answer) under `messages` (streaming with `stream_metadata=True`: on the closing usage chunk). Append them, `history += r["messages"]`, and the next turn resends exactly what the model saw, so the prompt cache keeps hitting. Responses moves its transcript to `messages` too; `items` still reads, with a DeprecationWarning, until a later release removes it.
- **Results read like the official SDKs.** Protocol lanes return `ChatObject`: still a dict, and also readable by attribute the way the official SDK reads the same JSON, `r.choices[0].message.content`. A Messages stream ends with `get_final_message()` / `get_final_text()`, and a Responses stream opens with `response.created` then `response.in_progress`.
- **Token usage, failures included.** Local indexing returns `usage`, and own-model chat `usage` lists each model call (a `claude-code/` model reports the total). A failed run carries what it spent on `PageIndexAPIError.usage`, and an answer cut short (length, content filter, refusal) raises instead of returning half an answer, with the text so far on `partial_answer`.
- **`create_metadata_schema(folder_id, fields)`** declares the metadata fields a folder's documents may carry; chat's metadata search filters, sorts and counts by them. Cloud only.
- **Local agent tools describe themselves like the cloud MCP server**, so a prompt written against one reads the same tool text on the other.
- **BREAKING: Messages stream events are dicts.** `chat(protocol="messages", stream=True)` yields `ChatObject` dicts instead of Anthropic SDK event objects. `event.type`, `event["type"]` and `event.model_dump()` all work, but `isinstance` / `match` against the SDK's event classes no longer matches, and setting an attribute (`event.delta.text = ...`) leaves the event unchanged: edit the dict (`event["delta"]["text"] = ...`).
- **BREAKING: `extra_body` no longer takes `model`, `folder_id` or `api_base`.** Pass `model=`, `folder_id=` or `backend=` instead.
- **litellm 1.105.1 or newer, below 1.106**, until 1.106's mcp import is fixed. `pip install -U pageindex` picks a matching version.

Also in 0.4.4:

- **A missing login says how to log in.** Indexing on a `claude-code/` model without a Claude login, or with an expired one, now fails in one short error that ends with the fix: run `claude`, then /login. Errors from sync `submit_document()` and `chat()` calls, on any model, no longer show an unrelated `RuntimeError: no running event loop` above them.

Also in 0.4.3:

- **Quieter Claude runs.** On Python 3.12 and earlier, `claude-code/` runs and apps using `as_claude_mcp()` no longer print asyncio's "… will report returncode 255" warning.
- **An old Agent SDK says so.** With a `claude-agent-sdk` older than 0.2.166, `claude-code/` models now stop up front with the command that fixes it, `pip install -U "pageindex[claude]"`.
- **A subscription example.** [`cookbook/pageindex-claude-subscription.py`](https://github.com/VectifyAI/PageIndex/blob/main/cookbook/pageindex-claude-subscription.py) indexes a paper with `claude-code/haiku` and streams an answer from `claude-code/opus`.

Also in 0.4.2:

- **Run on your Claude subscription.** Set `index_model` or `chat_model` to a `claude-code/` model, e.g. `chat="claude-code/opus"`, and indexing and `chat()` call Claude models through Claude Code: usage is covered by your plan, and no API key is needed (`pip install -U "pageindex[claude]"`). Local indexing on it runs in Flash mode.

Also in 0.4.1:

- **Flash reads filings right.** The "Table of Contents" link at the top of every page no longer hides a filing's headings (an AmEx 10-K had its first 131 pages in one node, and now indexes about 30% cheaper). Notes numbered 20 and on join the outline, two audit reports with the same title keep a heading each, and a slide built up page by page is one section.
- **Expand in any script.** Tree expansion now splits sections titled in Chinese, Japanese, Arabic, Hindi and other scripts, asks again after a reply it cannot parse, and keeps a short node's own text up to the summary length (`summary_max_words`) rather than a fixed 200 tokens.
- **More providers.** Node summaries turn reasoning off on models LiteLLM does not flag, OpenRouter's among them, and `chat(protocol="responses" | "messages")` sends the model name as you wrote it, so OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible services such as OpenRouter work on those lanes.

Also in 0.4.0:

- **Cheaper Flash indexing.** A leaf summarizes only its own text, the document description reads the top-level summaries, node summaries default to `reasoning_effort="none"` on models that accept it (`summary_reasoning_effort` picks another value), and expand asks once per section and splits only when the pieces are cheaper to read than the whole.
- **New default models.** Local mode indexes with `gpt-6-luna` and answers with `gpt-6-sol` when no model is set. A cloud client without a chat model still uses the managed chat.
- **litellm 1.105.0 or newer**, the first release that knows gpt-6-luna. `pip install -U pageindex` upgrades it.

Also in 0.2.22:

- **Flash keeps words whole.** Word gaps are measured from each character code's font width, so page text and titles no longer split words like "infe rence", and a chapter heading matches its bookmark again.
- **Steadier Flash trees.** Indexing no longer fails with "dropped or changed after it was marked final", a running header no longer cuts an intro or the Preface a page early, and expand keeps only the subsections printed inside a node. `optimize_tree(pdf_path)` and the `tree_optimize` CLI read two-column pages in layout order and no longer need pymupdf.
- **Standard mode.** The large-section split no longer loops forever when the model lists a heading above the section's own (a "PART II" above "Chapter 3"), and a TOC item never ends before it starts.

Also in 0.2.21:

- **BREAKING: one tree shape, local and cloud.** `get_tree` nodes carry `start_index`, `end_index` and `summary` in both modes; `page_index` and `prefix_summary` are gone. In a newly indexed document a parent's range and summary cover its whole section, and the pages before its first subsection become a `"<title> (intro)"` node. Documents indexed earlier keep their own ranges and summaries.
- **Local `get_ocr(format="node")` returns each node's own text.** A parent's text stops at the page its first subsection starts on, and is empty when an intro node holds that opening; intro nodes appear as their own entries. Documents indexed earlier read this way too, without re-indexing.
- **Node navigation.** `get_node`, `get_node_parent`, `get_node_path` and `get_node_map` in `pageindex.utils` take the tree from `get_document_structure()` and walk it locally, so one fetch serves any number of lookups.
- **Standard mode summarizes like Flash.** Each section summary starts as soon as its subsections are done, and short nodes keep their own text.

Also in 0.2.20:

- **Faster Flash indexing.** Node summaries run deepest node first and start while tree expansion is still deciding, so the model channels never sit idle: a 222-page report indexes in 73 s instead of 98 s, a 758-page book in 137 s instead of 174 s. Each summary is now capped at `summary_max_words` (default 150), which cuts the summary stage by another third to half.
- **Indexing knobs on the client.** `summary_max_words`, `summary_concurrency`, `use_embedded_toc` and `optimize` are settable on `PageIndexClient(...)` or in the `index=` slot (local Flash mode), and `--summary-max-words` / `--summary-concurrency` join the CLI. `summary_concurrency` lowers the whole indexing lane at once for a tight rate limit.
- **Anthropic lanes take your model as written.** `chat(protocol="messages")`, `anthropic_runner_config()` and `claude_agent_config()` use the `chat_model` you set, so `model=` is no longer required. The prefix picks the route: `bedrock/`, `vertex_ai/` and `azure_ai/` go to Bedrock, Vertex AI and Azure AI Foundry, anything else to Anthropic directly. The `[anthropic]` extra now requires `anthropic>=0.122.0`.
- **`list_documents`** accepts `limit` up to 10,000 (was 100), and local clients accept `folder_id="root"`.

Also in 0.2.19:

- **BREAKING: `resolve_citations` renamed to `get_citations`.** The list-returning method shipped in 0.2.17 is now `client.get_citations(answer, doc_id=...)`. Same arguments, same result.
- **`resolve_citations` returns display-ready citations.** `client.resolve_citations(answer, doc_id=...)` now returns `{"answer": ..., "citations": [...]}` — the answer text with each citation tag replaced by a numbered markdown link `[[1]](#pageindex-citation-01)`, and each citation's full data led by `anchor` and `index`.
- **`highlight_region`** draws a translucent highlight over a bounding-box region on a page image. Accepts a PIL Image or raw bytes, returns a new PIL Image. Importable from `pageindex`.
- **`get_page_image`** and **`get_document_image`** return short-lived URLs to page images and OCR-extracted embedded images. Cloud only.
- **`get_document_path`**, **`get_folder_path`**, **`get_folder_id`** translate between IDs and readable paths like `"Research/Papers/attention.pdf"`.
- **`get_document_id` accepts a path**: `client.get_document_id("Research/Papers/report.pdf")` strips the folder part automatically.
- **`list_documents(recursive=True)`** returns documents in subfolders.
- **Shared naming rules** for document uploads and folder creation, aligned with Chat and Compute.

Also in 0.2.18:

- **`get_document_id(name)`** looks up a document's ID by its display name in one API call, useful for resolving citation doc names to IDs.
- **Prompt alignment**: the SDK's local citation and discovery prompts now match the chat MCP server — the invented "Sources" footer is removed, a missing rephrase-and-retry persistence step is restored, and the SDK-only pagination tutorial is removed from the discovery instructions.

Also in 0.2.17:

- **Citations resolve to page coordinates.** `client.get_citations(answer, doc_id=...)` reads the citation tags in a cited answer — the `<cite doc="…" page="…" block="…"/>` tags `chat(citations=True)` writes and the `<doc=…;page=…;block=…>` tags the managed chat writes — and returns one entry per citation with the document's id; for a block-level citation on a cloud document indexed with `beta_headers=["block_reference"]`, the entry also carries the block's page, bounding box, type and text. Pass `doc_id=` (what `chat(doc_id=...)` took) to scope the name lookup, or omit it to resolve against your library.
- **One block, one call.** `client.get_block(doc_id, block_id)` returns a single layout block as the API serves it — `{doc_id, page, block_id, bbox, block_type, text}`, `bbox` as `[x0, y0, x1, y1]` in thousandths of the page's width and height (0-1000), origin top-left. Cloud only; local page content has no blocks.
- **Flash indexes every document, in every script.** Layout decides the tree, never the script: small documents, slide decks, and Japanese, Arabic, Hebrew, Indic, Thai and mixed-script PDFs that used to be refused or lose their headings now index, and the same layout yields the same headings in every script. When no hierarchy is detected, the tree falls back to one node per page (`toc_source="pages"`); pages before a late first heading get a `Preface` node, so every page is reachable from some node; `toc_source` is on every result (`detected`, `bookmarks`, `hybrid`, `pages`, `unreadable`).
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/VectifyAI/PageIndex/compare/v0.4.7...v0.5.0
Wei-Shaw/sub2api:
> AI API Gateway Platform - 将 AI 订阅配额分发和管理

新增按操作与资源范围授权的管理员 API Key；OpenAI / Composite 分组支持按实际出图张数计费，并新增 GPT-6.1 Terra 模型支持。

## 新增功能

- 管理员 API Key：可按操作和资源范围授权，支持过期时间和 IP 白名单；只保存不可逆摘要，撤销记录保留用于审计
- 按张计费：OpenAI 和 Composite 分组新增「按张计费」开关（默认关闭），一次生成多张图时按上游实际返回的张数计费，只对专用图片端点生效
- OpenAI：支持 GPT-6.1 Terra 模型
- Gemini：同账号重试次数可通过 gateway.max_same_account_retries_gemini 配置（默认 4，范围 0–10）
- Grok：管理端新增账号模型目录诊断，可查看来源、可信状态和与本地映射的差异；手动同步和后台观察统一使用同一套解析规则

- Grok：原生 Responses 和各转换路径都会记录上游原始响应模型，便于审计

## Bug 修复

- 修复 Gemini 以 fileData 形式返回的图片未计费的问题
- 修复渠道按次计费的图片档位丢失 token 用量的问题
- 修复 DeepSeek V4 Pro 在 9 月 14 日之后定价失效的问题
- 修复 DeepSeek prompt_cache_hit_tokens 未计为缓存读取的问题
- 修复 OpenCode 转发 DeepSeek 时 developer 角色导致 422 的问题
- 修复 Antigravity 非流式畸形工具调用返回空成功响应的问题
- 修复超大 multipart 图片上传被静默截断的问题，现在直接拒绝
- 修复分页参数过大时偏移量溢出导致 500 的问题
- 修复管理员保护规则校验返回 500 的问题，现返回 400
- 修复保存渠道时覆盖 web_search_emulation 平台维度的问题
- 修复模型广场分组模型定价被图片兜底档位覆盖的问题
- 修复 Grok 模型目录快照被失败请求、乱序请求或旧表单覆盖的问题

## 升级指南

Huge thanks to @paxcut - The pattern editor now supports semantic syntax highlighting for the PatternLanguage! - Matching brackets are now highlighted when the cursor is next to one - Patterns can now be opened in an external Editor and ImHex will update the pattern live when the file changes - Parenthesis and quotes are now auto-closed when typing them - Breakpoints in the pattern editor can now be toggled by clicking on the line numbers instead. - Fixed various scrolling and scrollbar issues - New and updated Languages! - Added a French translation. - By writing a pattern with these attributes, you can load the pattern using the new `imhex --save-editor ` option to show only a simplified save editor UI - This can also be done using the Web Version of ImHex by appending `?save-editor=` to the URL where `` is the ID of a GitHub Gist containing the pattern file - Added a "Go To" command to the command palette for quickly jumping to specific offsets - Added new "Go To First/Last Element" buttons to the data inspector - Added option to show extended/unprintable ASCII characters in the Hex Editor view - Vastly improved the auto updater - Added support for updating nightly builds - Added support for switching between stable and nightly channels - Added command palette option to open / focus a specific view - Added option to skip over large chunks of bytes with the same value - Added all tools to the command palette for quick access - Added a Markdown renderer to ImHex - The Changelog in the About page now uses this to render the changelog nicely - Bookmark comments can now also use Markdown formatting - Added a new File Information command line option that can show various information about a file without opening it - This can be used by running `imhex --file-info ` - If this file is supported by a pattern, it will also be loaded and additional information can be displayed - This works by it calling the pattern's `get_data_description` function if it exists which may then return any markdown text to be displayed - This information will also be displayed in the Data Information view - Added a "Decode as Encoding" option to the right-click menu in the Hex Editor view for quickly decoding selected bytes using a specific character encoding - It's now possible to jump to Yara matches in the Hex Editor by clicking on them - Added a region sidebar list to the Intel Hex and Motorola SREC providers. Idle it uses around 60MB now instead of over 200MB before - Pretty much everything has a nice new icon now - ImHex now builds and runs on 32-bit Windows systems - No official 32-bit builds will be provided, but you can build ImHex from source for 32-bit Windows now if needed using MSVC - Decluttered and modernized many parts of the UI - The main menu items now update automatically depending on what view is currently focused - This makes it much easier to figure out which option affects what, especially for things like "Open" which can apply to multiple views - Added Subpixel Font Antialiasing. Huge thanks to @paxcut - This makes all text look significantly nicer, especially on lower resolution screens - Fonts can now be more freely chosen using a new Font File picker that updates immediately - Font names in the picker are now also shown in their respective font - Frame Rate limiting is now much more precise and ImHex will wake up from sleep less often - ImHex will now also not limit the frame rate as much if there's any animations playing to allow for a smoother feel - Updated all dependencies to their latest versions - The Import Pattern popup now shows up much quicker. Thanks to @paxcut - If a crash happens in a background thread, ImHex is now able to properly handle the crash instead of just silently exiting ## Artifacts - Added new ARM64 builds for Windows and Linux - Added new Snap packages for Linux - Added new Flatpak packages for Linux - Added a Fedora 43 rpm package - Added a Ubuntu 24.04 deb package ## Pattern Language - Templates are now much better supported. Huge thanks to @AkiSakurai - They can now be nested properly - Their scoping now works much more sensibly - If you used Templates before, you might need to adjust your patterns. Wilfred/difftastic:
Difftastic is a structural diff tool that understands syntax. See [the manual](https://difftastic.wilfred.me.uk/introduction.html) to get started, and [the changelog](https://github.com/Wilfred/difftastic/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md) for historical changes.

### Diffing

Improved preprocessing heuristics, so difftastic should be faster and fall back to text diffing less often.

### Parsing

Updated Haskell (the previous version was prone to crashing) and Kotlin parsers.

Improved delimiter and trailing punctuation handling in: C, C++, C#, Elixir, Erlang, Gleam, Go, Java, JavaScript, Kotlin, Haskell, Nix, OCaml, Python, TypeScript and YAML.

Removed Smali support (upstream parser is no longer maintained).

Removed support for Verilog and F# due to the very large parser size making the difft binary big. Adding support for dynamically loading parsers in a future release should allow users to parse these languages again.

### Display

Fixed an issue with inline display where unchanged lines between two nearby changes were not shown.

Fixed an issue (introduced in 0.71) where the terminal width wasn't detected when stdin, stdout and stderr were all redirected. This was most noticeable when using difft with jj.

# oh-my-codex v0.21.43

`0.21.43` is a small patch release that corrects native process identity recovery guidance in `omx doctor`.

## Highlights

- **PROCESS IDENTITY RECOVERY GUIDANCE (#3971):** When the native process identity provider is unsupported or unavailable, `omx doctor` recommends `omx update` to hydrate the release-asset runtime cache. The guidance retains that session pointer recovery works without the native runtime.

## Fixes and compatibility

- Removed `omx setup` from the Process identity cache-repair hint; setup does not repair the native runtime cache. Other failure cases retain their existing reinstall/update guidance.
- No breaking API changes. Package, npm lockfile, Cargo workspace/lockfile, and plugin metadata were already synchronized to `0.21.43` by #3970; the release branch does not double-bump them.

## Known issues and exclusions

- The separate provider-unavailable report in #3968 (reporter Kevin-wenyu) remains unconfirmed; evidence was requested. This release corrects the remediation text and does not claim to fix the underlying reported provider failure.
- #3898 remains held for the owner design decision. Related PRs #3939, #3900, #3907, #3915, and #3919 remain excluded.
- #3965 is not included; changes were requested and the work is split pending. No other user-visible changes in the compare range are excluded.

# Motrix 2.1.1

English | [简体中文](https://github.com/agalwood/Motrix/blob/v2.1.1/docs/release-notes/2.1.1.zh-CN.md)

Motrix 2.1.1 increases the configurable download concurrency and fixes false
path conflicts during legacy task migration.

## Changes since 2.1.0

- Raise the simultaneous-download setting from 1–100 to **1–200**, keeping
  the default at **10**. Values above 100 remain intact after saving other
  settings and restarting the application. Addresses the requested limit
  increase in [#2439](https://github.com/agalwood/Motrix/issues/2439).
- Stop treating display names and output hints from unresolved legacy magnet
  tasks as owned file paths. Multiple magnet tasks can be imported without
  false path conflicts, and those hints no longer block unrelated HTTP or
  BitTorrent task activation. Existing-file protections for tasks with actual
  output ownership remain in place. Fixes
  [#2437](https://github.com/agalwood/Motrix/issues/2437).
- Update form resolvers, virtual lists, layout and icon dependencies, along with
  Biome and pnpm. Update electron-builder to **26.18.1** and electron-updater to
  **6.8.12**, including fixes for differential-download redirects and cached
  block maps. `vscode-jsonrpc` remains at **9.0.3**, Electron at **45.1.0**, and
  the bundled engine at **aria2 1.37.0-motrix.21**.

## Downloads and updates

Desktop packages support macOS 13 or later, Windows 10 or later, and Linux,
with native x64 and ARM64 builds. No 32-bit desktop packages are provided.
macOS DMG and ZIP packages are signed and notarized. Windows NSIS installers
and ZIP archives are unsigned and may trigger SmartScreen; download them from
the official GitHub Release.

Stable publication updates both `latest*.yml` and `beta*.yml` feeds to 2.1.1.
Flatpak bundles and Native Host companions are separate downloads. Snap builds
first reach `latest/edge`; the same verified amd64 and arm64 revisions are then
promoted through candidate to stable.

Server images use the immutable tags `docker.io/motrixapp/motrix-server:2.1.1`
and `ghcr.io/agalwood/motrix-server:2.1.1`. After public multi-platform runtime
verification, the `2.1`, `2`, `stable`, and `latest` aliases advance to this version.

Back up your profile and download files before upgrading. Users migrating
from Motrix v1 should follow the
[migration guide](https://github.com/agalwood/Motrix/blob/v2.1.1/docs/legacy-migration.md)
and retain their original profile and engine database backups.

## Known limitations

BitTorrent hash checks during restart or recovery still share the download
concurrency quota. Raising the limit does not add parallel hash checking or
separate verification scheduling. Tasks that have entered seeding remain
excluded from the quota with the default `bt-detach-seed-only=true` setting.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/agalwood/Motrix/compare/v2.1.0...v2.1.1)

# Nacos 3.3.0

Nacos 3.3.0 is a feature iteration release for the Nacos 3.x series. It brings protocol-neutral Agent management and discovery, shared AI resource search, and unified MCP lifecycle management to the stable release.

This release focuses on:

- AI Registry capabilities across Agent, AgentSpec, Skill, Prompt, and MCP resources.
- DNS service discovery and distributed locks.
- Dynamic plugin management and authentication enabled by default.
- Spring Boot 4 and Jackson 3 compatibility, with improved client and server reliability.

The main feature updates include:

- Agent registration, version management, runtime endpoints, RAD discovery, transport negotiation, and Watch/Push through Java SDKs and Console workflows.
- Shared AI resource search with hybrid keyword and vector retrieval, artifact access, and optional relevance filtering.
- MCP draft, review, publish, online/offline, and visibility management, with migration support for historical resources.
- Optional DNS discovery with A, AAAA, and SRV records over UDP and TCP.
- Distributed reentrant and non-reentrant locks with watchdog renewal and Raft consistency.

The stable release also improves Skill metadata consistency across version transitions, extends visibility plugin capabilities, and strengthens Config SDK usability, Console compatibility, and recovery after Naming reconnects and cluster restarts.

These notes are cumulative and include the changes delivered in 3.3.0-BETA and 3.3.0-RC.

---

Detailed changes in this release:

## Feature

- [#50](https://github.com/alibaba/nacos/issues/50) Add optional DNS service discovery over UDP and TCP, with A, AAAA, and SRV records, metrics, and configurable external DNS forwarding.
- [#14466](https://github.com/alibaba/nacos/issues/14466) Add a neutral JSON adapter with Jackson 2 and Jackson 3 runtime support.
- [#14804](https://github.com/alibaba/nacos/issues/14804) Add protocol-neutral Agent lifecycle management, Console workflows, RAD discovery, runtime endpoints, transport negotiation, Watch/Push, and Java SDKs.
- [#15279](https://github.com/alibaba/nacos/issues/15279) Add distributed reentrant and non-reentrant locks with watchdog renewal, FIFO waiting, gRPC notifications, Raft consistency, and a Java Lock SDK.
- [#15471](https://github.com/alibaba/nacos/issues/15471) Support SkillSpector as an AI publish pipeline.
- [#15475](https://github.com/alibaba/nacos/issues/15475) Add unified dynamic plugin configuration, lifecycle management, runtime updates, deterministic discovery, and Console configuration workflows.
- [#15476](https://github.com/alibaba/nacos/issues/15476)[#15604](https://github.com/alibaba/nacos/issues/15604) Add plugin-owned visibility grant and revoke APIs and Console management for Skill and AgentSpec resources.
- [#15541](https://github.com/alibaba/nacos/issues/15541) Add Agentic Resource Discovery with search, exploration, artifact retrieval, visibility filtering, persistent indexes, and hybrid keyword and vector retrieval.
- [#15640](https://github.com/alibaba/nacos/issues/15640) Add Linux RISC-V64 compatibility for RocksDB JNI loading and startup.
- [#15761](https://github.com/alibaba/nacos/issues/15761) Add shared MCP lifecycle management with drafts, review, publish, online/offline operations, visibility, Java SDKs, and historical reconciliation while preserving existing Config/Naming serving data.

## Breaking Change Notice

Nacos 3.3.0 changes authentication defaults, disables selected deprecated APIs, and introduces migration requirements. Applications using the new Agent SDK from BETA or RC also need to review the finalized subscription contract.

Affected users:

- Applications relying on Client APIs without credentials or on deprecated Pipeline and MCP import endpoints.
- Deployments with legacy Config data, historical AI storage keys, untagged Raft logs, or A2A/MCP resources requiring migration.
- Applications relying on built-in Prometheus client metrics or implicit AI resource visibility defaults.
- BETA/RC adopters using RAD subscriptions or remotely accessing the optional DNS server.

Recommended upgrade path:

- **Prepare Client API credentials.** An absent `nacos.core.auth.enabled` now means `true`. Existing explicit `false` settings remain effective. If necessary, keep authentication explicitly disabled during credential provisioning, then enable it consistently across the cluster after verifying client access. Admin and Console authentication defaults are unchanged.
- **Migrate deprecated AI API calls.** Selected legacy Pipeline and Console MCP import endpoints return HTTP `410` with `API_DEPRECATED` by default. Use the Pipeline `/list` and `/detail` endpoints and unified `/v3/console/ai/import/validate` and `/execute` endpoints. `nacos.core.api.compatibility.enabled=true` temporarily reopens the selected endpoints; `nacos.ai.resource.import.legacy-mcp-api-enabled` is no longer recognized.
- **Complete legacy Config migrations.** Upgrade pre-3.0 deployments through an earlier Nacos 3.x version. Migrate default-namespace data from the empty tenant to `public`, and legacy beta/tag data to `config_info_gray`. For the `nacos_config` AI storage provider, explicitly migrate affected historical non-ASCII or overlength Config coordinates to the deterministic ASCII-safe mapping.
- **Check persisted Raft logs.** Nacos 3.3 no longer replays untagged entries, including entries originally written by Nacos 2.0.x and retained through intermediate upgrades. Recover and migrate those logs or snapshots with a compatible version before upgrading; changing the running version alone does not convert persisted logs.
- **Plan historical A2A and MCP migration.** The default `nacos.ai.a2a.compatibility.mode=CANONICAL` does not scan historical A2A data. Follow the [A2A upgrade runbook](https://github.com/alibaba/nacos/blob/043954fdf52bceaf1be2d14b04072010220ceed3/specs/en/ai/a2a-upgrade-migration-spec.md#9-upgrade-runbook) for `AUTO` migration and early-3.3 preflight. After permanent canonical cutover, legacy-only servers must not rejoin. Preserve MCP reconciliation state and its existing Config/Naming serving data during the one-way lifecycle transition.
- **Keep cluster server identities consistent.** Native JRaft authentication becomes enforced after all members advertise support, and enforcement persists across restarts. Rolling downgrades to members without JRaft credential support are not guaranteed to remain available.
- **Update BETA/RC Agent SDK consumers.** The new RAD `subscribeAgent` methods now return `void`. Receive both initial state and subsequent updates through the Listener, prepare Listener state before subscribing, and recompile dependent applications. Legacy A2A signatures and HTTP/gRPC wire contracts remain unchanged.
- **Configure client metrics explicitly.** `nacos-client` no longer includes a mandatory Prometheus client dependency. Install an implementation of `NacosClientMetricsProvider` when metrics are required; without one, recording is a no-op even when `enableClientMetrics` is enabled.
- **Review MCP import and visibility settings.** Private or local MCP import targets require `nacos.console.ai.mcp.import.allowed-private-addresses`, and redirects are not followed. The built-in visibility plugin defaults newly created Agent and MCP resources to `PUBLIC`; explicitly choose a private scope where required. Existing stored scopes and Prompt/Skill defaults are unchanged.
- **Review DNS listener configuration.** DNS remains optional and disabled by default. When enabled, `nacos.naming.dns.bind-address` defaults to `127.0.0.1`; configure the intended listening address for remote clients. External forwarding requires separate explicit configuration.
- **Refresh affected Skill metadata.** Historical Skill descriptors without parsed frontmatter retain their existing metadata; this release does not automatically read their packages or backfill missing metadata. Update the content or re-upload affected Skills to regenerate frontmatter and correct previously stored multiline descriptions.
- **Back up and rehearse the upgrade.** Back up the database and persisted server data, then verify authentication, data migration, discovery, and client behavior in staging. Embedded Derby is upgraded to 10.16.1.1, so include persisted-data reads, subsequent writes, and restart recovery in upgrade validation.

Deployments without the affected historical data do not require those data migrations. The authentication defaults and any applicable API or SDK changes still need review.

## What's changed

- Added `permissions.blockWritesOutsideWorkingDirectories`: Write, Edit and NotebookEdit refuse paths outside the working directories in every permission mode
- Added an optional `groups` list to Claude apps gateway upstreams: only developers in the listed IdP groups are sent to that upstream, on failover too
- Added `guardrail_trace` to Claude apps gateway Bedrock upstreams, to log which Amazon Bedrock guardrail filter fired on a request, without the matched text
- Added idle compaction to VS Code and Claude Desktop's Code tab: a 200K+ token conversation left idle is summarized, and the summary is used on your next message if the prompt cache has expired
- Fixed sessions failing turn after turn with "Invalid effort level" when an organization's admin caps a model's effort: Claude Code now lowers the effort, retries, and says which level it uses
- Fixed `claude -p` exiting with code 0 and no output when startup failed; it now prints the error and exits 1
- Fixed Bedrock sessions with many images failing every turn and `/compact` with "400 Input is too long." instead of removing older images and compacting
- Fixed Microsoft Foundry sessions failing when the resource has no deployment for the default Sonnet, Opus or Haiku model: Claude Code now falls back to an older model of that family
- Fixed repeated refused requests behind a gateway that doesn't accept tool search's `tool_reference` blocks: the request is sent again once without tool search, and the session remembers
- Fixed TLS connections failing with `UNABLE_TO_GET_ISSUER_CERT` when the system certificate store holds a renewed root certificate that is cross-signed with its predecessor
- Fixed MCP servers that also work without sign-in showing "needs authentication" after their stored sign-in stopped working; they are now used signed out
- Fixed `claude mcp logout` reporting success when the MCP sign-in was not removed, for example while the macOS keychain is locked over SSH
- Fixed extra sign-in renewals when several sessions share an Anthropic profile login and the credentials lock is busy
- Fixed `claude ultrareview` and `claude remote-control` asking the workspace trust question in a CI job that has a terminal; with `CI` set they now refuse an untrusted folder at once
- Fixed an administrator's TLS trust settings in managed settings not being applied in Claude Desktop sessions
- Fixed model switching being refused on machines with managed plugin settings when one of your own `--plugin-dir` or `--plugin-url` plugins had a broken manifest or failed to download
- Fixed the Bedrock and Vertex model upgrade offer coming back at every start when managed settings pin the model
- Fixed `forceRemoteSettingsRefresh` set only in remote managed settings no longer applying once the stored copy had expired, which let sessions start without policy when the server could not be reached
- Fixed "Continue automatically at usage limit" continuing more than three times without a prompt from you when a task restarted itself between waits (a /goal check-in, a background or scheduled task)

- Fixed the last broken reply and its retry prompts staying in the conversation after Claude gave up on a tool call that could not be parsed
- Fixed a PreCompact hook with very large output making compaction fail or repeat; each hook's output is now cut at 10,000 characters

# 中文

本次 Next 更新将上游升级至 DeepSeek Harness v0.2.1-rc.4，优化应用启动速度与窗口状态恢复，升级恢复助手的 Profile 修复、撤销与故障报告能力，支持 `dshfind` 插件索引，并将内置 Agents Anywhere 插件升级至 2.1.0（支持 Codex 会话交接与双端轮流对话、依赖环境重装及历史消息顺序修复）。

DSH NEXT 是社区维护的开源项目，并非 DeepSeek 官方产品。

**上游版本：** [DeepSeek Harness v0.2.1-rc.4](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/releases/tag/dsh-v0.2.1-rc.4)。

## 新增与改进

- **启动速度与窗口体验:** 加快 macOS 无系统代理时的网络探测与启动环境变量加载，并启用前端脚本编译缓存以提升二次启动速度；自动记忆并恢复主窗口的位置、尺寸与最大化状态。
- **恢复助手与 Profile 修复:** “备份并修复当前 Profile”现会先创建完整备份，将 Profile 重置为默认模板插件并重新进入首次设置引导，同时在“快速恢复”页新增“撤销上次修复”支持一键还原；打开恢复助手时自动生成单文件故障报告，并采集本地崩溃转储与内存快照以便排查。
- **插件来源与 `Computer Use (Next)`:** “来源配置”新增 `dshfind` 插件索引一键填充与切换，“自定义插件市场”统一更名为“自定义插件索引”；桌面内置 Computer Use 插件更名为 `Computer Use (Next)`（命令仍为 `/computer-use`）。
- **Agents Anywhere 2.1.0:** 支持在网页端直接接力正在运行的 Codex 桌面会话，查看会话保持只读、仅在发言或操作时短暂接管，实现电脑与手机在同一会话轮流对话；会话顶部切换模型或权限立即生效，Agent 提问改为会话内异步表单；“设置 → 维护”新增“重装依赖环境”，支持切换 PyPI 镜像重建运行环境并自动从官方源补齐缺失包。

## 修复

- **macOS 重启权限保持:** 修复 macOS 下切换 Profile、恢复重启或插件变更重启后可能丢失系统“本地网络”权限的问题。
- **会话链接容错:** 对话中出现无法解析的 `dsh-session:` 文本时按普通文本保留，不再导致当前轮次对话报错中断。
- **Linux 打包与兼容:** 新增 Linux ARM64 打包校验；Linux AppImage 改用静态运行时，不再依赖系统安装 `libfuse.so.2`；修复 Next 打包时的社区市场依赖解析问题及上游 ACP 模式诊断输出混入 `stdout` 的问题。
- **Agents Anywhere 同步稳定性:** 修复接入已有 Codex 会话后历史消息乱序或交错的问题（升级后下次同步自动校准），消除搜索、图片查看与上下文压缩产生的重复记录，并修复多插件连接同一 Codex 时的交接超时与异常序号写入阻塞问题。

## 使用提示

- 请先退出旧版应用并备份 `~/.dsh`（或在“设置 → 桌面设置”中使用“备份”），安装后验证常用插件和工作流程。
- 如需通过应用内终端管理 `desktop` Profile 的插件，请先启动 Desktop 完成该 Profile 的初始化。
- 从 2.0.17-next 或更早版本升级时，建议手动下载安装；旧版应用内更新可能无法完成下载。
- Office 文档技能首次使用时将随包运行时安装到 `~/.dsh/dsh-runtimes/dsh-next-primary-runtime`，需要额外磁盘空间。
- 默认与旧稳定版共用 `~/.dsh`；Profile 不隔离同一目录中的会话、账号和凭据。
- 可在“设置 → 桌面设置”或恢复助手中切换数据目录，也可通过绝对路径 `DSH_DESKTOP_NEXT_HOME` 隔离 DSH 数据（应用内选择优先于环境变量），但不会因此隔离 AA 的默认共享登录与设备绑定状态。

# English

This Next release upgrades upstream to DeepSeek Harness v0.2.1-rc.4, improves launch speed and window state restoration, upgrades Profile repair, undo, and failure reporting in the recovery assistant, adds `dshfind` plugin index support, and upgrades the bundled Agents Anywhere plugin to 2.1.0 (adding Codex session handoff and dual-device turn-taking, dependency environment reinstallation, and history ordering fixes).

DSH NEXT is a community-maintained open-source project, not an official DeepSeek product.

**Upstream version:** [DeepSeek Harness v0.2.1-rc.4](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/releases/tag/dsh-v0.2.1-rc.4).

## New and improved

- **Startup speed and window experience:** Sped up macOS proxy detection when no system proxy is set and parallelized login-shell environment loading, enabled frontend script compilation caching for faster warm launches, and persisted the main window’s position, size, and maximized state across restarts.
- **Recovery assistant and Profile repair:** "Back up and repair current Profile" now creates a full backup before resetting the Profile to default template plugins and re-running first-launch onboarding, with a new "Undo last repair" action on Quick Recovery for one-click restoration. Opening the recovery assistant automatically generates a single-file failure report and captures local crash dumps and memory snapshots for troubleshooting.
- **Plugin sources and `Computer Use (Next)`:** Added one-click `dshfind` plugin index configuration and switching in Source Configuration, renamed "Custom plugin markets" to "Custom plugin indexes", and renamed the bundled desktop Computer Use plugin to `Computer Use (Next)` (keeping the `/computer-use` command).
- **Agents Anywhere 2.1.0:** Continue running Codex desktop sessions directly from the web while keeping viewing read-only and taking over briefly only when sending messages or performing actions so desktop and mobile can take turns in the same session; model and permission changes in the session header take effect immediately, and agent questions now use in-session async forms; added "Reinstall dependency environment" under **Settings → Maintenance** with PyPI mirror switching and automatic fallback to official PyPI for missing packages.

## Fixes

- **macOS permission preservation on restart:** Fixed in-app restarts (Profile switches, recovery restarts, and plugin changes) potentially losing macOS Local Network permissions.
- **Session link resilience:** Preserved undecodable `dsh-session:` text in conversations as plain text instead of failing the turn.
- **Linux packaging and compatibility:** Added Linux ARM64 packaging verification; switched Linux AppImage to a static runtime so `libfuse.so.2` is no longer required on the host system; fixed community market peer dependency resolution during Next packaging and upstream ACP diagnostics leaking into `stdout`.
- **Agents Anywhere sync stability:** Fixed out-of-order or interleaved history after attaching to an existing Codex session (automatically recalibrated on the next sync after upgrading), eliminated duplicate timeline entries from searches, image views, and context compaction, and fixed multi-plugin Codex handoff timeouts and oversized sequence number write stalls.

Use `SHA256SUMS.txt` from this release to verify all installers.

## Usage notes

- Quit the previous version and back up `~/.dsh` (or use **Back up** in **Settings → Desktop settings**) before installing. Verify your usual plugins and workflows afterward.
- Before managing plugins for the `desktop` Profile from the bundled terminal, launch Desktop to initialize that Profile.
- When upgrading from 2.0.17-next or earlier, download and install manually; in-app updates in those versions may not complete the download.
- The Office skills install the bundled runtime under `~/.dsh/dsh-runtimes/dsh-next-primary-runtime` on first use, requiring additional disk space.
- Defaults to the shared `~/.dsh` home. Profiles do not isolate sessions, accounts, or credentials within that home.
- Change the data directory in **Settings → Desktop settings** or the recovery assistant, or set `DSH_DESKTOP_NEXT_HOME` to an absolute path to isolate DSH data (an in-app choice takes precedence over the environment variable); this does not isolate AA’s default shared sign-in and device-binding state.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/anywhere-labs/dsh-desktop/compare/v2.0.20-next...v2.0.21-next) · [Project website](https://dshdesktop.cn)

## Significant Changes

### Backfill endpoints no longer disclose which backfill ids exist across Dags

  The four routes that name a backfill in their path -- ``GET /backfills/{backfill_id}``
  and the ``pause``, ``unpause`` and ``cancel`` routes -- resolved the Dag they authorize
  against from the ``dag_id`` supplied on the request whenever the path's id matched no row.
  An unknown id and a backfill on a Dag the caller cannot see therefore answered differently,
  which enumerates backfill ids across Dags.

  The backfill named in the path is now the only thing those routes authorize against.

  **Behaviour changes:**

  - Requesting a backfill on a Dag the caller cannot read now returns ``404``
    (``Backfill not found``) -- the same response an unknown id gets -- instead of the
    ``403`` returned before. A caller who can read the Dag still gets ``403`` for a write
    they are not allowed to make.
  - A ``backfill_id`` in the path is never authorized against a ``dag_id`` in the request body
    or query string. ``GET /backfills``, ``POST /backfills`` and ``POST /backfills/dry_run``
    name no backfill in their path and keep authorizing off the request.
  - All four routes now answer an unknown id with the same detail, ``Backfill not found``.
    The ``pause``, ``unpause`` and ``cancel`` routes previously answered
    ``Could not find backfill with id {backfill_id}``. Clients matching on ``detail``
    must be updated. (#71113)

### An explicit credential now takes precedence over the session cookie

  ``get_user()`` is written to prefer an explicit bearer token, then OAuth2, then the
  session cookie, but that precedence was unreachable whenever a cookie was present.
  ``JWTRefreshMiddleware`` runs
  first, resolves a user from the ``_token`` cookie alone and stamps it on
  ``request.state``, and ``get_user()`` returned that cached user before looking at either
  explicit credential. The effective order on every core-API route was cookie over bearer.

  A request carrying both a session cookie and an explicit credential therefore executed,
  and was recorded in the audit log, as the cookie's principal rather than the identity the
  client presented. The cached user is now honoured only when the request carries no
  explicit credential.

  **Behaviour changes:**

### A request carrying **both** a ``_token`` cookie and an ``Authorization: Bearer`` header
    is now resolved as the bearer token's principal, where it was previously resolved as the
    cookie's. The same applies to a cookie combined with an OAuth2 token.
### An **invalid or expired** explicit credential is now rejected with ``401``/``403`` even
    when a valid ``_token`` cookie accompanies it. Previously the cookie silently took over
    and the request succeeded as the cookie's principal; the failure is now loud.
### Requests carrying a single credential are unaffected. Cookie-only browser sessions keep
    the token-refresh behaviour of ``JWTRefreshMiddleware`` unchanged.
### Clients that relied on the cookie winning -- for example a browser-based tool that sent a
    service account's bearer token while a user session cookie was present, and expected the
    user's identity to apply -- will now act as the bearer token's principal. Remove the
    header, or the cookie, to select the intended identity explicitly. (#72225)
