debpalash/VoiceStudio:
**First, an apology.** This release took much longer than it should have. Urgent family matters kept me away for a while, and I'm sorry for the wait and for the issues that sat unanswered meanwhile. Thank you for your patience and for every report, fix and kind word in the meantime.

**Welcome Shimul Debnath ([velixio](https://github.com/velixio)) to the core team.** Shimul now helps maintain VoiceStudio — reviewing pull requests, triaging issues and keeping releases moving — so the project no longer waits on one person.

**VoiceStudio now runs on your phone and on PCs without a GPU, and the whole app is calmer.** Preview iOS and Android apps run models on the phone itself, GPU-less computers get the small CPU PyTorch build, and the sidebar, Models, Dubbing, Stories and Workflows pages were redesigned around fewer, clearer controls.

This release also adds an opt-in Beta update channel, a bottom player for takes, a GPU acceleration panel with honest Radeon reporting and the Ask VoiceStudio Agent, plus hundreds of fixes to cloning, dubbing, audiobooks, downloads and dictation.

**Download**

| Platform | Installer |
| --- | --- |
| Windows x64 | [Installer](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.7/VoiceStudio-0.5.7-win-x64.exe) |
| Windows ARM64 (experimental) | [Installer](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.7/VoiceStudio-0.5.7-win-arm64.exe) |
| macOS Apple Silicon | [DMG](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.7/VoiceStudio-0.5.7-mac-arm64.dmg) |
| macOS Intel | [DMG](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.7/VoiceStudio-0.5.7-mac-x64.dmg) |
| Linux x64 | [AppImage](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.7/VoiceStudio-0.5.7-linux-x64.AppImage) · [deb](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.7/VoiceStudio-0.5.7-linux-x64.deb) · [Snap Store](https://snapcraft.io/voicestudio) (`sudo snap install voicestudio`) |
| Android | [APK](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.7/VoiceStudio-0.5.7-android.apk) · [AAB](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.7/VoiceStudio-0.5.7-android.aab) |
| iPhone | [Sideload IPA](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.7/VoiceStudio-0.5.7-ios-unsigned.ipa) — sign with your own Apple ID |

**Upgrading:** Install over your existing Electron app; voices, projects and settings are kept. If setup asks, choose **Install local runtime** to refresh its dependencies.

- Remote compute devices, remote workers and GPU sharing moved to VoiceStudio Pro and are no longer in the open-source app; saved projects, voices and settings are unaffected (#2748)
- Models without a plainly commercial licence, including the default OmniVoice model, ask you to accept their licence once in Model Catalogue; until then, API and MCP requests that use them return a licence error (#2689)
- Docker, LAN or reverse-proxy access by a host name, without an API key or session, needs that name in `OMNIVOICE_ALLOWED_HOSTS`; IP addresses, `localhost`, `*.ts.net` and `host.docker.internal` work as before.
- URL imports from servers on your own network need `OMNIVOICE_ALLOW_PRIVATE_URL_IMPORTS=1`.
- [Where to set these variables](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/blob/v0.5.7/docs/api-auth.md#requests-from-other-websites-and-host-names): a line in `~/.config/omnivoice/env` (macOS, Linux) or `%USERPROFILE%\.config\omnivoice\env` (Windows) for the desktop app, `-e` for Docker.

**Moving from Tauri:** Close the app, back up its data directory, install Electron, and verify your voices and projects before removing Tauri. Follow the [migration guide](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/blob/v0.5.7/docs/electron-migration.md). Tauri v0.5.3 remains the final Tauri release; its updater cannot install Electron.

**Installer trust:** macOS installers are signed. Windows installers are not code-signed yet, so SmartScreen may warn; the **Installer signing** table above shows each platform's result. See the [installation guide](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/blob/v0.5.7/docs/install/troubleshooting.md).

### Phone apps

Preview builds that run models on the phone, offline once they are downloaded.

| File | Use |
|---|---|
| [VoiceStudio-0.5.7-android.apk](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.7/VoiceStudio-0.5.7-android.apk) | Android: install directly (allow installs from this source) |
| [VoiceStudio-0.5.7-android.aab](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.7/VoiceStudio-0.5.7-android.aab) | Android App Bundle for Google Play |
| [VoiceStudio-0.5.7-ios-unsigned.ipa](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.7/VoiceStudio-0.5.7-ios-unsigned.ipa) | iPhone: unsigned device build; sideload with your own Apple ID (for example, Sideloadly) |

The iPhone IPA was built from the same v0.5.7 source tag. It is not a TestFlight/App Store build; App Store signing is currently blocked by Apple’s certificate limit. Verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

### Installer signing

| Platform | Signing |
|---|---|
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | ✅ Signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple |
| macOS (Intel) | ✅ Signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple |
| Windows x64 | ⚠️ Unsigned: SmartScreen shows "Windows protected your PC"; choose More info → Run anyway |
| Windows ARM64 | ⚠️ Unsigned: SmartScreen shows "Windows protected your PC"; choose More info → Run anyway |
| Linux x64 | — Linux packages are not code-signed |
| Android | ✅ Signed with the VoiceStudio release key |
| iPhone | Unsigned sideload IPA: sign with your own Apple ID; App Store signing remains blocked by Apple’s certificate limit |

- A calmer app: redesigned sidebar, one Models list per family, cleaner Dubbing, Stories and Workflows pages, and a bottom player for takes

- Voice cloning finds the speech-to-text model you installed from Model Catalogue and explains clips that are too long (#2442, #2498) — thanks [drakeo338](https://github.com/drakeo338), [Bad-ptr](https://github.com/Bad-ptr)!
- Opt-in Beta update channel in Settings → Updates: get fixes early and roll onto the next stable release automatically

### CI

- The release helper opens a release pull request and tags `main` after it merges, instead of pushing to `main` (#3492)
- Release builds no longer fail on the Intel Mac runner over a test that assumed the host can install the local runtime (#3490)
- Avoid false stuck-loading reports when background polling overlaps UI crawler checks. (#3383)
- Pull requests from forks wait for a maintainer's approval before CI uses any runner, so outside PRs can no longer queue the whole matrix unreviewed (#3341)
- CI: the macOS release signing check retries Apple's staple validation, so a dropped connection no longer fails a tag run (#3330)
- CI finishes about four minutes sooner: the UI crawler's route shards are balanced by cost and the platform smokes no longer wait for the Electron tests (#3310)
- Pull requests can merge through a merge queue that tests each one once on the latest `main`; the workflows are ready, a maintainer turns the queue on in the ruleset (#3309)
- Pull requests that only change locale files or package.json no longer start the iOS and Android builds; `main` still builds on them (#3308)
- Settings no longer crashes in the smoke and UI-crawler builds: the test Vite config now defines the build commit, and a guard test keeps every renderer config in step with `env.d.ts` (#3304)
- The Electron renderer smokes run as their own CI job and the UI crawler is split into three shards, so the slowest CI job drops from ~21 to ~9 minutes (#3303)
- A test now pins that a backend missing health checks during a model download is shown as unresponsive and recovers on its own instead of being declared failed (#3185) — thanks [nirmalchatur](https://github.com/nirmalchatur)!
- The mobile workflow captures Google Play phone screenshots of the Android app on an emulator and keeps them as a download (#3277)
- Pull requests that only change Python, docs, mobile or non-Electron workflows skip the Electron-only CI jobs (UI crawler, Desktop UI, native package), cutting their CI time from ~26 to ~8 minutes; deleted or renamed files, unknown paths and a failed lookup always run everything (#3271)
- CI cancels a pull request's older run when it is pushed again, older Docker builds on main are cancelled, and review-bot comments no longer take a runner, so mass pushes stop flooding the queue (#3260)
- Release notes open with the installer signing table, so you see which downloads are signed before the changelog (#3255)
- macOS release builds retry once when Apple's ticket server drops the notarization staple, instead of failing the whole release (#3244)
- Release notes list everyone who contributed since the last stable release automatically, instead of only the people thanked by hand (#3242)
- Release notes list each platform's installer signing as measured on the build, and a macOS build that would open as "damaged" can no longer be released, and macOS releases are signed with the Developer ID again (#3241, #3243)
- The owner can let named maintainers publish releases while Windows installers are still unsigned (#3236)
- Android release and Play builds share an increasing version code to prevent reused or decreasing build numbers (#2969)
- Phone build resources keep notice hashes and localized text intact on Windows (#2969)
- New `mobile-release` workflow builds signed Android and iOS apps and drafts a GitHub prerelease with the APK, AAB and IPAs (#2969)
- The `mobile` workflow builds the pinned on-device runtimes for both apps (#2969)
- The main test step runs in parallel with pytest-xdist, about 3 minutes faster per CI run (#3223)
- Interactive release helper: pick stable or beta, draft or publish, and confirm by typing the tag (`scripts/release.py`) (#3187)
- Release helper choices are arrow-key menus (#3190)
- Desktop UI tests no longer fail at random when Electron's debugger takes the dev proxy's port; the proxy now binds an OS-assigned port (#3126)
- Desktop request-guard self-tests stay deterministic when app requests arrive during cleanup (#2676)
- New `mobile` workflow builds and tests both phone apps; a contract test fails when their theme or API description drifts from the desktop app (#2965)
- iOS TestFlight workflow: maintainers can upload a signed iPhone build for internal testers from `main` ([guide](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/blob/v0.5.7/docs/mobile.md#testflight-maintainers)) (#3188)
- iOS TestFlight builds declare their exempt encryption, so uploads no longer wait on the export compliance question (#3230)
- iOS TestFlight uploads with on-device inference pass App Store validation, and the workflow checks every bundled framework before uploading (#3235)
- Beta and stable release builds no longer fail when a slow build machine runs the app's tests (#3232)
- Android Play internal testing workflow: the matching signed Android upload from `main`, and beta versions no longer break the Android build ([guide](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/blob/v0.5.7/docs/mobile.md#play-internal-testing-maintainers)) (#3189)
- Gallery preview fallback smoke no longer flakes when a slower runner reads the playing clip in several byte ranges (#3018)
- The Windows ARM64 installer is built for ARM64 only, and the packaging rehearsal runs on Windows, Intel Mac and ARM64 without host-specific test failures (#2615)
- Pull requests fail when a commit uses a leaked personal email, a placeholder identity, or an AI agent identity, or when a commit or the description credits an AI agent (#2556)
- GitHub Actions are pinned to exact commits and kept current by Dependabot (#2556)
- Release Docker images publish when the GitHub Release is published; `:latest` only ever comes from `main` (#2578)
- One bun, TypeScript and Playwright version and one lockfile across the workspace; frontend unit tests run in the required check (#2578)
- Tests keep the review-bot configs, issue-template labels and locale catalogs consistent (#2578)
- Trusted base-branch checks reject leaked, placeholder, and AI agent identities while allowing human co-authors with names shared by agents (#2556)

deepfakes/faceswap:
**Installer for Faceswap.py**

This installer will install missing prerequisites (Git, MiniConda, PyTorch), set up the environment and create a Desktop shortcut for launching straight into the FaceSwap GUI. If running this installer, you do not need to manually install any programs yourself.

For **Nvidia** users it will install a local version if CUDA and cuDNN into a Conda environment. A CUDA 11.8+ capable graphics card is required.

For **AMD** Users The ROCm version of Torch will be installed, but you will need to ensure that you have ROCm 6.0-6.4 installed to enable use of AMD Graphics cards.

# Windows Users
**Note: Only Nvidia + CPU are supported under Windows. To use AMD cards, you will need to use Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL2) and run the ROCm version of Faceswap.**

You only need to download the file [faceswap_setup_x64.exe](https://github.com/deepfakes/faceswap/releases/latest/download/faceswap_setup_x64.exe) from this page. You should **not** run the installer as an Administrator.

**NB:** It may, at times, look like the installer has hung. It hasn't. The installer has to download and install a lot of prerequisites, and it is impossible to retrieve a live update of the output into the Details window. Please be patient.

**IMPORTANT**: Windows SmartScreen may flag this program as unsafe. This is because it needs to download third party applications from the internet. It is entirely safe, and the source code can be reviewed here: https://github.com/deepfakes/faceswap/tree/master/.install/windows If you are still not convinced, you can review the source code and compile the installer yourself.

# Linux Users
You only need to download the file [faceswap_setup_x64.sh](https://github.com/deepfakes/faceswap/releases/latest/download/faceswap_setup_x64.sh) from this page.

Just download and run as a normal user:
```bash ./faceswap_setup_x64.sh```
Then follow the prompts.

# Mac Users
Just run the following command in `Terminal` to download and run the install script:
```
bash <(curl -s https://github.com/deepfakes/faceswap/releases/latest/download/faceswap_setup_macos.sh)
```
Then follow the prompts

If the above doesn't work, then download the file  [faceswap_setup_macos.sh](https://github.com/deepfakes/faceswap/releases/latest/download/faceswap_setup_macos.sh) from this page then execute as a normal user:

```bash ./faceswap_setup_macos.sh```

buildx 0.38.1

Welcome to the v0.38.1 release of buildx!



Please try out the release binaries and report any issues at
https://github.com/docker/buildx/issues.

### Security

This release has been built with updated Go runtime 1.26.10 to address [CVE-2026-111943](https://go.dev/issue/82345) by rejecting certificate chains that include eight revoked eMudhra intermediate certificates.
Image pulls and pushes fail TLS certificate verification if a registry's certificate chain relies on one of the affected TLS intermediates.
Affected registries need a replacement certificate chain that does not use these intermediates.

The blocked intermediates are:

- Domain-validated TLS: `EM DV TLS CA - G3B` and `EM DV TLS CA - G3C`
- Organization-validated TLS: `EM OV TLS CA - G3B` and `EM OV TLS CA - G3C`
- Extended-validation TLS: `EM EV TLS CA - G3B` and `EM EV TLS CA - G3C`
- Code signing: `EM OV CS CA - G3B` and `EM OV CS CA - G3C`

The G3B intermediates belong to eMudhra BV, and the G3C intermediates belong to eMudhra Inc.
The keys for these intermediates were compromised.

[Read more about the eMudhra Intermediate CA Compromise](https://emudhra.we-have-a-problem.com/)

There are no functional changes in Buildx itself compared to the previous release.



Previous release can be found at [v0.38.0](https://github.com/docker/buildx/releases/tag/v0.38.0)

docmirror/dev-sidecar:
### 一、更新内容：

#### 【摘要】

v2.3.3 修复了开启 npm 加速时代理进程因无限递归而崩溃的问题，并集中处理了安装、更新与证书信任三块：安装器和卸载器现在每次都会给出「是否删除用户数据」的选项；Windows 增量更新遇到 `Program Files` 不可写时会请求 UAC 提权；CA 环境变量改为指向「系统根证书 + DS CA」的合并包，不再只信任 DS 自己的证书。功能上新增了 Xget 加速插件和一键反馈（打包日志、运行参数并预填 issue），并修复了网页诊断页报错、npm 缺失时的错误提示等问题。

#### 【新特性】

- **Xget 加速插件**：启用并填写 Xget 实例地址后，会把 Xget 的平台加速规则合并进配置。实例地址支持子路径、http 与端口；规则按用户本地配置的优先级合并，用户自己的同名规则仍然优先；关闭插件即移除规则。
- **一键反馈（#42）**：帮助中心「反馈问题」按钮和托盘菜单都能一键打包 `~/.dev-sidecar/logs` 下的日志、`running.json` 与环境信息，生成 `年-月-日-时-分-秒 Logs.zip`。打包前对 token/password/authorization 等字段打码；`running.json` 与日志一起打进压缩包，打包完成后自动打开所在目录并选中文件，用户把压缩包拖入 issue 页面即可。issue 标题和正文按模板预填。
- **安装选项常显**：安装器每次都会显示「安装选项」页，用户可选择是否删除已有的 `~/.dev-sidecar`。升级安装默认不勾选，保留原配置。
- **彻底卸载**：卸载器新增「卸载选项」页，勾选后一并删除 `~/.dev-sidecar`，完成彻底卸载。静默卸载和升级时的旧卸载器不会显示该页，也不会删除数据。

#### 【优化】

- **Windows 增量更新请求 UAC**：安装目录不可写时，不再直接失败或强制下载完整包，而是请求管理员权限，由提权进程结束应用、解压增量包并重启。
- **增量包补齐**：CI 现在上传 `linux-arm64` 和 `linux-armv7l` 的增量包，更新器也支持 armv7l；增量包缺失或写入失败时仍会回退完整安装包。
- **CA 环境变量改为合并包**：`REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE`、`SSL_CERT_FILE`、`CURL_CA_BUNDLE` 指向 `~/.dev-sidecar/ca-bundle.pem`，内容为 Windows 证书存储（Root，排除 Disallowed）/ macOS 系统钥匙串 / Linux 系统 CA 包，加上 DS CA；每次开启系统代理时重新生成。合并包不做 CRL/OCSP 吊销检查，详见 `doc/caroot.md`。
- **预发布版本比较按 semver**：修复 `beta.100 < beta.99`、`alpha.10 < alpha.9` 这类按字符串比较导致的误判，数字段现在按数值比较。
- **反馈信息更可读**：issue 里的系统版本改为 `Windows 11 10.0.26300 (x64)`、`macOS 14.7.2 (arm64)`、`Ubuntu 24.04 …` 这类名称。
- **fork 的 CI 发布标记为 alpha**：非官方仓库构建出的 Release 标题带 `-alpha.<run_number>` 并标记 prerelease，不会占用 latest（对普通用户无影响）。
- **默认窗口更大**：默认尺寸改为 1200×860，最小 960×640，启动居中，并限制在当前屏幕工作区内，小屏不会被挤出可见范围。
- **更新检查与下载改用 Electron 网络栈**：GitHub 资产会跨域重定向到 `release-assets.githubusercontent.com`，原 `request` 客户端经本地代理会挂起或报 Parse Error；改用 Chromium 网络栈后跟随重定向、代理与证书校验都更稳。
- **版本规则文档化**：新增 `doc/versioning.md`，记录 alpha/beta/dev/rc/正式版的优先级与更新策略。

#### 【问题修复】

- **修复开启 npm 加速时代理进程栈溢出**：npm 插件的包装函数 runNpm 内部把自己也替换成了 runNpm，导致无限自递归，开启 npm 加速时代理进程报 `Maximum call stack size exceeded` 并停止工作；现已恢复为调用 `shell.exec`。
- **修复网页诊断页报 `l.loadURL is not a function`**：主窗口未开启 `webviewTag`，`<webview>` 只是普通元素；现已开启。
- **修复 macOS 打开 npm 页面报 `Api invoke error`（#427）**：系统找不到 npm 时不再直接抛 `/bin/sh: npm: command not found`，改为提示安装 Node.js 或把 npm 命令填成绝对路径。
- **修复安装器没有「全新安装」选项**：之前检测到旧安装就跳过安装选项页，现在每次安装都会显示。
- **修复卸载器没有「彻底卸载」选项**：改为独立的卸载选项页，勾选后删除用户数据。
- **修复 Windows 增量更新写入失败**：`Program Files` 下 `resources` 普通权限不可写，现走 UAC 提权解压。
- **修复安装包构建失败**：卸载页误用了 include 阶段尚未定义的 `isUsed` 宏，导致 makensis 编译报错。
- **修复 Linux/macOS 安装根证书必失败**：`@vscode/sudo-prompt` 的 `name` 只接受字母数字和空格，原来的 `dev-sidecar` 含连字符，在校验阶段就被拒绝；同时装有 p11-kit 的 Debian/Ubuntu 被 `hasCmd('trust')` 误判为 Arch。现在名称改为 `devsidecar`，Arch 只按 `/etc/arch-release` 或 pacman 源判断。
- **修复检查更新/自动更新报 Parse Error 或卡在 0 字节**：更新流程不再使用 `request`，检查更新和下载都改走 Electron 网络栈；下载增加 60 秒无数据超时与 404 提示。

#### 【其他】

- 新增安全报告流程：说明支持版本范围、报告渠道（GitHub 私密报告 / PGP 加密邮件）与 PGP 指纹，并处理代码扫描告警。
- 添加 .dockerignore，把 node_modules 与构建产物排除出 Docker 构建上下文。

### 二、安装前请仔细阅读安装说明

[各平台安装说明](https://github.com/docmirror/dev-sidecar/wiki/%E5%90%84%E5%B9%B3%E5%8F%B0%E5%AE%89%E8%A3%85%E8%AF%B4%E6%98%8E)

win10/macOS Monterey以下版本的用户参见[electron升级说明](https://github.com/docmirror/dev-sidecar/issues/733)

从 2.3.2 升级：2.3.2 自带的更新器在下载 GitHub 资产时可能报 Parse Error 或卡在 0 字节，若自动更新失败请直接手动下载安装包；安装 2.3.3 之后，后续版本才会使用修复后的更新链路。2.3.3 起 Windows 支持 UAC 提权的增量更新。

### 三、贡献者列表

dolthub/dolt:
# Merged PRs

## dolt

* [12203](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/pull/12203): nbs: deduplicate archive dictionaries by content
  Fix dolthub/dolt#12177
* [12198](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/pull/12198): Build virtual merge bases in UTC
  Column defaults that read the time, like CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, give it in the session's time zone, so a virtual merge base built with a non-deterministic timestamp. This matters because `dolt_merge_bases` orders by time stamp. Since no one
  actually sees the virtual commit, we'll build it with the session time zone set to UTC, and restore the session's own afterwards.
* [12194](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/pull/12194): nbs: allocate chunk journal write buffers and index maps on demand
  - Lazily allocate `journalWriter.buf` on write and retain a 64 KB baseline (`journalWriterMinBuffSize`) across flushes to minimize idle journal footprint while preventing allocation churn.
  - Initialize `rangeIndex.novel` with zero initial capacity to eliminate static map overhead and scale lookup memory strictly with indexed chunks.
  - Add cross-platform `get_memory_kb` bats helper to get PID memory usage.
  Fix dolthub/dolt#12179

## go-mysql-server

* [4062](https://github.com/dolthub/go-mysql-server/pull/4062): Do not hoist filters out of the null side of a lateral join
  fixes dolthub/dolt#11552
  `hoistOutOfScopeFilters` pulls filters that only reference an outer scope out of a derived table. for a lateral derived table on the right of a join that's wrong: in `LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT o.id + 1 AS tag WHERE o.id = 1) AS q ON TRUE` the `o.id = 1` filter decides whether `q` has a row for that `o`, it shouldn't filter `o` itself. at the top level there was nothing to hoist it into, so the query failed with `rule 'hoistOutOfScopeFilters' tried to hoist filters above root node`. hoisted filters from a derived table that is a non-preserved child of a join (`IsPreservedTable`) now stay inside it as a filter. derived tables inside `EXISTS` and `IN` subqueries aren't join children like that, so they still get hoisted as before.
  the new script in `SubqueriesScriptTests` covers the query from the issue, the same thing with an inner `JOIN LATERAL`, and a `LEFT JOIN LATERAL` over a table that mixes an inner and an outer filter. all three failed with the error above and pass now, and i checked the expected results against mysql 8.4. the rest of `./sql/...` and `./enginetest/...` has the same results as main under `-tags gms_pure_go`.
* [4059](https://github.com/dolthub/go-mysql-server/pull/4059): Apply sql_select_limit to simple selects and DISTINCT
  fixes dolthub/dolt#11549
  a non-default `sql_select_limit` was ignored in two places. the simple-select batch in `getBatchesForNode` (a `Project` over a `ResolvedTable`, with or without a `Filter`) did not run `applyDefaultSelectLimit`, so `set @@sql_select_limit = 2` followed by `select * from t` or `select x from t where y > 1` returned every row. the rule now runs in that batch too. separately, `applyLimit` did not handle a `Distinct` root, which is what the query from the issue plans to:
  ```sql
  select distinct row_number() over (order by x) as rn from t order by rn;
  ```
  an explicit `LIMIT` is still planned above the `Distinct`, so it keeps taking precedence over the session limit.
* [4058](https://github.com/dolthub/go-mysql-server/pull/4058): execute multiple statements in stored procedure exit handlers
  Currently, the stored procedure handler logic assumes there is exactly one statement for exit handlers.
  This PR fixes the handler to execute _all_ the queries within a stored procedure handler.
  However, like other parts of the stored procedure logic, the result set is discarded.
  Related:
  - https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/7454
  - https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/12199
* [4057](https://github.com/dolthub/go-mysql-server/pull/4057): Skip costed index scan for non `MATCH...AGAINST` filters on fulltext indexes
  fixes dolthub/dolt#12175
  Costed index scans should only work on full text indexes with a `MATCH...AGAINST` filter. However, we should not be erroring out when the filter is not a `MATCH...AGAINST`; the filter should instead work like a regular filter.
  This PR removes emitting an error when a non `MATCH...AGAINST` filter is on a fulltext index. It also skips calculating the cost in the first place for fulltext indexes with non `MATCH...AGAINST` filters.
* [4056](https://github.com/dolthub/go-mysql-server/pull/4056): Fix accidentally dropping filters in complex joins
  Dolt PR: https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/pull/12193
  The join order planner did not properly check that all joins were actually included in the new plan. This PR fixes that.
  There's potential room for improvement here, both in detecting when filters are redundant and what to do when the current join order planning fails. But this fixes a potential correctness issue.
* [4054](https://github.com/dolthub/go-mysql-server/pull/4054): create larger decimal precision during comparisons
  We were choosing the wrong decimal scale/precision when comparing column decimals against literals.
  Fixes https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/12185
* [4047](https://github.com/dolthub/go-mysql-server/pull/4047): Fix type coercision for `GREATEST` and `LEAST` functions
  This PR fixes the resulting and comparing types for `GREATEST` and `LEAST` functions to more closely follow MySQL. Combinations of types result in string type output, which we defaulted to `DOUBLE` in many cases. The presence of DATE/DATETIME/TIMESTAMP types causes other types to be converted and compared as the corresponding temporal type, and then converted to the appropriate output type (usually string).
  Passing Dolt bump: https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/pull/12187


# Closed Issues

* [11548](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/11548): Dolt mis-evaluates a correlated anti-join over a derived ROW_NUMBER() result
* [11552](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/11552): Dolt reaches an analyzer internal error for a legal correlated LEFT JOIN LATERAL
* [11549](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/11549): Dolt drops sql_select_limit
* [12177](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/12177): DOLT_GC duplicates archive dictionaries once an archive has more than 256, pinning ~137 KB of C memory per duplicate
* [12175](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/12175): Full-Text index is selected for ordinary equality and IS NULL filters, causing unknown expression errors
* [12185](https://github.com/dolthub/dolt/issues/12185): DECIMAL comparison precision against literals isn't converted correctly

dragonflydb/dragonfly:
## This is a patch release.

### What's Changed

- Fixed a crash when `DFLYMIGRATE` was sent to a server that is not in cluster mode. It now returns the standard "Cluster is disabled" error ([#8290](https://github.com/dragonflydb/dragonfly/pull/8290)).
- Fixed a crash on glob patterns with many `*` wildcards in `KEYS`, `SCAN`/`HSCAN`/`SSCAN`/`ZSCAN MATCH`, ACL key patterns, `PSUBSCRIBE` and `CONFIG GET`. Matching is now iterative, so it no longer overflows the fiber stack, and it is also faster ([#8350](https://github.com/dragonflydb/dragonfly/pull/8350)).
- Fixed a crash in blocking commands when a watched key holds a value of the wrong type. The registered blocked keys are now cleaned up ([#8305](https://github.com/dragonflydb/dragonfly/pull/8305)).
- Fixed a crash when restoring an HNSW vector index while a key is being deleted concurrently ([#8466](https://github.com/dragonflydb/dragonfly/pull/8466)).
- Fixed ACL permission checks for commands that both read and write keys (such as `COPY` or `LMOVE`). Source keys are now checked for read access and destination keys for write access ([#8249](https://github.com/dragonflydb/dragonfly/pull/8249)).
- Fixed `INFO persistence` reporting `rdb_bgsave_in_progress:1` forever after a `BGSAVE`. `rdb_last_bgsave_status` is now also updated when a background save finishes ([#8459](https://github.com/dragonflydb/dragonfly/pull/8459)).
- In emulated cluster mode, replicas now advertise the master's announced address in `CLUSTER NODES`/`SLOTS`/`SHARDS`, instead of the address passed to `REPLICAOF` ([#8241](https://github.com/dragonflydb/dragonfly/pull/8241)).
- The daily version check now also sends anonymous deployment info: architecture, I/O backend, cloud provider, thread count, kernel version, uptime and a `maxmemory` bucket. No keys, data, hostnames or addresses are sent. ([#8469](https://github.com/dragonflydb/dragonfly/pull/8469)).

Full Changelog: [v2.0.0...v2.0.2](https://github.com/dragonflydb/dragonfly/compare/v2.0.0...v2.0.2)

earendil-works/pi:
### New Features

- **Image input for classifiers**: codemode `models.classify()` accepts `images` for TypeSafe's Jev and Cloudflare's Clef models on `typesafe`, `cloudflare-workers-ai`, and OpenRouter. See [Use classifier models](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.4.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/models.md#use-classifier-models) and [Codemode](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.4.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/codemode.md#models).
- **Models Configuration reference**: every provider, model, model override, and compatibility field of `models.json`, generated from its schema. See [Models Configuration](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.4.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/models-configuration.md).
- **Summaries without a fixed output cap**: compaction and branch summaries use the model's output limit, so long reasoning no longer makes them fail. See [Compaction](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.4.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/compaction.md#compaction).
- **Codemode waits for a free worker**: parallel scripts and in-process subagents queue instead of failing, and `PI_CODEMODE_MAX_WORKERS` raises the limit. See [Codemode limits](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.4.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/codemode.md#limits).
- **Rex terminal support**: OSC 8 hyperlinks, truecolor, and inline images.

### Added

- Added a Models Configuration reference generated from the `models.json` schema, listing all provider, model, model override, and compatibility fields ([#10790](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10790))
- Codemode `models.classify()` now accepts `images` for TypeSafe's Jev and Cloudflare's Clef models on `typesafe`, `cloudflare-workers-ai`, and OpenRouter, and lists Clef Omni and Jev 1.14 on Workers AI.
- Provider-level `compat` in `models.json` now also applies to classifier models, with the System One fields `imageInput` and `sendImageOptInHeader` for proxies that serve another service's classifiers. Extension classifier models accept `compat` too.
- Added `MiniMax-M3.1-Flash` to the `minimax` and `minimax-cn` providers, with thinking levels low through max ([#11121](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11121))
- Added support for the Rex terminal: OSC 8 hyperlinks, truecolor, and inline images ([#11131](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11131), [#11150](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11150) by [@petrroll](https://github.com/petrroll), [#11183](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11183) by [@nihaals](https://github.com/nihaals))

### Changed

- Provider attribution headers now come from pi-ai's client identity. Extensions' `before_provider_headers` handlers no longer see the OpenRouter, NVIDIA NIM, and OpenCode attribution headers; returning `null` for one still removes it. Cloudflare requests send pi's detailed `User-Agent` instead of `pi-coding-agent`, as do GitHub release checks for tool downloads, and OpenCode requests send `x-opencode-client` whenever attribution is enabled, not only with a session.
- `generateSummary()` and `generateSummaryWithUsage()` now ignore their `reserveTokens` parameter. Summary requests use the model's output limit instead.
- Changed the default GitHub Copilot model from `gpt-5.4`, which Copilot retired, to `gpt-6.1-sol`.
- Changed the default NVIDIA model to `nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl-120b-a12b` ([#10910](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/10910) by [@cv](https://github.com/cv))
- Changed the default Xiaomi model to `mimo-v2.6-pro` for the `xiaomi` and Xiaomi Token Plan providers, since `mimo-v2.5-pro` left the catalog.
- Grok 4.3 and Grok 4.5 on the `xai` provider now offer the `xhigh` thinking level.
- Sign in with ChatGPT: ChatGPT Business workspace usage-limit errors are not retried and tell the user to ask their workspace admin to increase the limit.

### Fixed

- Fixed compaction and branch summaries failing with "generation hit the token cap" when reasoning used most of the fixed summary output limit. Summaries now use the model's output limit, and `compaction.reserveTokens` only controls when compaction starts ([#9512](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/9512), [#9075](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/9075)).
- Fixed `models.schema.json` missing descriptions for provider and model fields, so editors showed no hints for them ([#10790](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10790))
- Fixed `pi update` failing with "Managed install marker is missing or invalid" when `managed-install.json` starts with a UTF-8 BOM, which Windows PowerShell 5.1 adds when it rewrites the file.
- Fixed HTML export showing literal asterisks for Markdown bold and italic next to CJK punctuation ([#3353](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/3353), [#10154](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10154))
- Fixed the terminal staying in mouse-tracking, focus-reporting, Kitty keyboard, and alternate-screen modes when pi exits without its normal terminal teardown, which flooded the shell prompt with escape sequences ([#11170](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11170))
- Fixed concurrent extension `select`/`confirm`/`input`/`editor` dialogs and inline `custom()` components in interactive mode: a second dialog replaced the first and the first promise never settled; closing the visible dialog now shows the previous one again ([#11166](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11166), [#9909](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/9909))
- Fixed pasting in the shell hanging after copying text in pi and suspending it with Ctrl+Z on Linux: the background `wl-copy`/`xclip`/`xsel` process that keeps serving the clipboard was suspended along with pi ([#11179](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11179))
- Fixed codemode scripts failing immediately when both codemode workers are busy, for example with parallel codemode calls or in-process subagents. Scripts now wait up to 60 seconds for a free worker, and `PI_CODEMODE_MAX_WORKERS` raises the limit of two workers ([#11184](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11184))
- Fixed extensions failing to load when importing `@earendil-works/pi-ai/models` (e.g. for `clampThinkingLevel`) by exposing the subpath through the extension loader aliases and virtual modules ([#11156](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11156))
- Fixed `mcp.json` files that start with a UTF-8 BOM failing to parse, which skipped all their MCP servers and made `pi mcp add`/`pi mcp remove` fail ([#11191](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11191))
- Fixed `/compact <instructions>` ignoring the instructions when summarizing the start of a turn that compaction splits. When the split turn was the only new content since the last compaction, the instructions were ignored entirely ([#11058](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11058))
- Fixed resumed sessions and `/tree` navigation leaving extension tools inactive when the branch recorded its tools before they were registered, such as tools from extensions installed after the session started. Extension tools the branch never added or removed are now active unless they are registered with `defaultActive: false` ([#11062](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11062), [#11075](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11075))
- Fixed sessions breaking after recovery from a response cut off at the output limit: the truncated tool call was omitted but its tool results were kept, so providers rejected every later request ([#11227](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11227), [#11233](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11233) by [@petrroll](https://github.com/petrroll))
- Fixed the `grep` tool following `RIPGREP_CONFIG_PATH`, where options such as `--fixed-strings` silently changed regex searches into literal ones. The tool now runs `rg --no-config` ([#11203](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11203), [#11230](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11230) by [@petrroll](https://github.com/petrroll))
- Fixed Windows shell detection rejecting runnable Microsoft Store shell aliases ([#9504](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/9504) by [@petrroll](https://github.com/petrroll))
- Fixed Windows shell detection missing PowerShell outside `PATH` and the legacy WSL `bash.exe` launcher when Windows is not installed in `C:\Windows`. pi now checks `%ProgramFiles%\PowerShell\7`, `%SystemRoot%\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0`, and `%SystemRoot%` ([#9501](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/9501) by [@petrroll](https://github.com/petrroll))
- Fixed GitHub Copilot sessions with large request bodies, such as many images, failing with HTTP 413 `failed to parse request` instead of compacting and retrying ([#11016](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11016) by [@petrroll](https://github.com/petrroll))
- Fixed the `openai-codex` provider offering `gpt-5.5` and `gpt-5.3-codex-spark`, which always fail for ChatGPT accounts ([#11173](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11173) by [@lucasmeijer](https://github.com/lucasmeijer))
- Fixed whitespace-only tool output (for example a bare `\r\n` from bash) making OpenAI Completions, OpenAI Responses, and Google requests fail with a 400 ([#8720](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/8720))
- Fixed automatic retry not triggering for more gateway upstream failures, `stream disconnected before completion` errors relayed by Codex CLI proxies, and transient Google Vertex OAuth token refresh failures, and retrying errors because of digits inside request ids or byte counts ([#10920](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10920), [#11057](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11057), [#10996](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10996))
- Fixed OpenAI Responses models losing the prompt cache on every deferred tool load after a tool was removed ([#10940](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10940))
- Fixed Cloudflare Workers AI classifier pricing: Clef Flash costs $0.038 and Jev $0.042 per million input tokens instead of Jev being listed as free.
- Fixed an unclosed `$$` display-math block swallowing or corrupting every Markdown table after it ([#11159](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11159))
- Fixed Markdown bold and italic not rendering next to CJK punctuation ([#10730](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/10730) by [@theBucky](https://github.com/theBucky))
- Fixed `@` file autocomplete returning no results for queries containing regex metacharacters such as `[` or `(` ([#10972](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10972))

## Fixes

* Fixed a crash on Linux when a D-Bus method call was made on a disconnected bus. [#55292](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55292) <sup>(Also in [44](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55290), [46](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55289))</sup>
* Fixed a main process crash when `onSendHeaders` observed Blob uploads. [#55169](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55169) <sup>(Also in [44](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55168))</sup>
* Fixed extension `chrome.webRequest` events reporting a `tabId` of `-1` and `chrome.declarativeNetRequest` rules restricted to tabs never matching. [#55283](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55283) <sup>(Also in [46](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55284))</sup>
  * Fixed `session.clearStorageData()` unregistering the service workers of loaded extensions.
  * Fixed `chrome.management` methods and events being unavailable to extensions with the `management` permission.
  * Fixed `__MSG_*__` placeholders not being localized in extension stylesheets.
  * Fixed extension service workers being stopped after 30 seconds while a WebSocket was active.
  * Fixed sandboxed extension pages being hosted in a process with extension API privileges.
  * Fixed extension service workers running an outdated script after an app restart when the extension's files changed without a version change.
  * Fixed `chrome.alarms` and content scripts registered with `persistAcrossSessions` not persisting across app restarts.
* Fixed File System Access blocklist gaps for `.git/hooks` writes and hypervisor UNC shares. [#55329](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55329)
* Fixed handling of malformed asar archives whose size fields do not match the file length. [#55175](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55175) <sup>(Also in [43](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55179), [44](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55176))</sup>
* Fixed inconsistent handling of asar archive paths between the main process and child processes. [#55184](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55184) <sup>(Also in [43](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55185), [44](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55183))</sup>
* Fixed `Menu.popup()` on macOS sometimes not showing a menu after another closed. [#55326](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55326) <sup>(Also in [44](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55325), [46](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55324))</sup>
* Fixed MV3 extension events not arriving to background service workers. [#55154](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55154) <sup>(Also in [43](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55153), [44](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55152))</sup>
* Fixed `protocol.registerSource` schemes not applying the same fetch rules as `protocol.handle` schemes. [#55178](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55178) <sup>(Also in [44](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55177))</sup>
* Fixed requests stalling when an extension used a blocking `chrome.webRequest` listener. [#55271](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55271) <sup>(Also in [46](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55263))</sup>
* Fixed `utilityProcess` not emitting an `exit` event when the app quit while the process was still launching. [#55274](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55274) <sup>(Also in [43](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55272), [44](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55273), [46](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55264))</sup>

* Updated Node.js to v24.22.1. [#55163](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55163)

### 1. Security

#### Elixir

* [URI] Bind port limits during `URI.parse` (CVE-2026-109821)
* [JSON] Raise when decoding integers in JSON beyond float64 ranges (CVE-2026-115274)

#### Mix

* [mix deps.partition] Validate `deps.partition` configuration with checksum on multi-user systems (CVE-2026-97209)

### 2. Enhancements

#### Elixir

  * [Calendar.ISO] Optimize `Calendar.ISO.parse_duration/1`
  * [Kernel] Improve boot time by parsing the Erlang/OTP release with `list_to_integer/1`

### 3. Bug fixes

#### Elixir

  * [Date] Fix `Date.from_gregorian_days/2` passing an invalid day fraction to non-ISO calendars
  * [Duration] Fix `Duration.from_iso8601/1` accepting a fractional seconds component after whole seconds, such as `PT1S2.5S`
  * [Duration] Reject inputs longer than 192 bytes in `Duration.from_iso8601/1`
  * [Regex] Raise `SystemLimitError` when a match reaches the regex engine match limit, instead of returning no match
  * [Registry] Do not crash on timeouts on `Registry.lock/3`
  * [String] Skip U+055F (Armenian abbreviation mark) when applying the Greek final sigma rule in `String.downcase/2` and `String.capitalize/2`
  * [Task] Do not leak timeout messages on `Task.async_stream/3`

#### IEx

  * [IEx] Do not halt the remote node when the remote shell receives EOF with `--remsh`
  * [IEx] Fix crash on tab completion when shell is not found

#### Mix

  * [mix xref] Fix outgoing compile-connected counts in `mix xref graph --format stats`

esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix:
本版新增项目栏「最近」跨项目找会话、每日定时深色模式和可关闭的输入框提示，并修复从旧版找回会话全部被跳过、更新失败后无法下载完整安装包等多处问题。

## 新增

- 项目栏新增「最近」：按最近活动时间跨项目列出会话，完整分页、可搜索；点选后定位到所属项目并打开会话，也可选择远程环境。关联 #14319 fixed in #14784 by @lancy69。
- 「外观 → 明暗」新增「定时」模式：每天按本机时间切换深色，默认 20:00 到次日 07:00，可跨午夜；桌面窗口的边框和底色同步变化。只有选择它时才生效。关联 #14699 fixed in #14783 by @lancy69。
- 「外观 → 会话显示」新增「输入框提示」开关：可隐藏输入框里的任务和排队占位文字，默认显示，只保存在本机。关联 #14759 fixed in #14781 by @lancy69。
- 文档：使用指南新增跨项目任务派发的完整流程。关联 #14603 fixed in #14780 by @lancy69。

## 变更

- 浏览器工具的说明现在提示模型读静态网页时用 web_fetch、用完关闭标签，避免一轮留下十几个页面。修复 #14737 fixed in #14764。
- 设置里「快捷键」页的卡片顺序调整：「Esc 停止任务」紧跟发送相关设置，全局快捷键和按键表放在后面。关联 #14789 fixed in #14790。

## 修复

- 从旧版找回会话时，目标文件夹里残留没有对话文件的过期索引，会让所有会话被反复跳过、一个都导入不了；现在会清掉它们并正常导入，侧栏里的未导入列表也能显示。修复 #14804 fixed in #14806。
- 更新失败后提示里的「下载完整安装包」改为用系统浏览器打开发布页，不再落到被设置页盖住的内置浏览器里。修复 #14775 fixed in #14788。
- 侧栏里「早先版本」和「恢复副本」那一行，悬停或键盘聚焦时重新显示删除按钮 ×。修复 #14703 fixed in #14803 by @xxoingr。
- 删除配置来源文件夹后，仍可移除残留的 MCP 服务；配置损坏时会保留服务，并指出无法解析的配置文件。关联 #14738 fixed in #14749 by @lancy69、#14739 fixed in #14749 by @lancy69。
- 连接远程主机（如 WSL）时，读取会话列表、删除、置顶或归档不再每次都重新建立连接；连接在最后一次操作后保留 45 秒。修复 #14745 fixed in #14763。
- 从对话分叉出的分支会继承源会话的上下文压缩简报，打开后继续在压缩视图上工作。关联 #14768 by @jf200s。
- 同一项目里并行启动的隔离任务不再偶尔因 Git 报 failed to read …/commondir 而失败。关联 #14805 by @xxoingr。
- 隔离结果应用、委派续跑和用量预算：应用时拒绝被换成目录链接的父目录，并发续跑不再重复创建转录副本，已知用量计入根预算，恢复任务时文件权限变化也会使旧证明失效。关联 #14025。

## 贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@lancy69、@xxoingr、@jf200s

## New

- The project header gains "Recent": conversations across projects by last activity, paged and searchable; picking one locates its project and opens it, also on remote hosts. Refs #14319 fixed in #14784 by @lancy69.
- Appearance → Light and dark gains a "Scheduled" mode: dark during a daily local-clock range (default 20:00–07:00, overnight allowed); the window frame follows. Opt-in. Refs #14699 fixed in #14783 by @lancy69.
- Appearance → Conversation display gains a "Composer hint" switch that hides the task and queue placeholder text; on by default, remembered on this machine. Refs #14759 fixed in #14781 by @lancy69.
- Docs: the guide now walks through cross-project task dispatch. Refs #14603 fixed in #14780 by @lancy69.

## Changed

- The browser tool now tells the model to read static pages with web_fetch and to close tabs when done, so a turn no longer leaves a dozen pages open. Fixes #14737 fixed in #14764.
- On the Shortcuts settings page, "Esc to stop" now sits right after the send settings, with the global shortcut and the key table after it. Refs #14789 fixed in #14790.

## Fixed

- Recovering older sessions no longer skips every conversation because of stale indexes with no transcript in the destination; they are cleared and the import proceeds. Fixes #14804 fixed in #14806.
- After a failed update, "download the full installer" opens the release page in the system browser instead of the in-app browser behind the settings sheet. Fixes #14775 fixed in #14788.
- An earlier version or recovery copy in the sidebar shows its delete × again on hover or keyboard focus. Fixes #14703 fixed in #14803 by @xxoingr.
- Stale MCP servers can be removed after their source folder is deleted; a malformed config names the file and keeps the servers. Refs #14738 fixed in #14749 by @lancy69, #14739 fixed in #14749 by @lancy69.
- On a remote host such as WSL, listing, deleting, pinning or archiving sessions no longer reconnects every time; the link is held 45 seconds after the last action. Fixes #14745 fixed in #14763.
- A fork inherits its source's compacted context, so the branch continues on the compacted view. Refs #14768 by @jf200s.
- Isolated tasks started in parallel in one project no longer fail now and then with Git's "failed to read …/commondir". Refs #14805 by @xxoingr.
- Isolated results and delegation: applying refuses a parent directory swapped for a link, parallel continuations no longer duplicate copies, and known usage counts toward budgets. Refs #14025.

esnet/iperf:
iperf-3.22 2026-09-29
---------------------

* Security notes

    * Thanks to Claude and Ada Logics for finding and reporting two
      potential security vulnerabilities. One is a remote
      use-after-free in iperf_server_api.c (ANT-2026-E5BA80X9 /
      CVE-2026-101283) and the other is a heap buffer overflow in
      iperf_auth.c (ANT-2026-FXH14FHV / CVE-2026-101276).

    * Thanks to Justin Stitt for reporting and fixing a heap-buffer
      overflow was fixed in iperf_auth.c (PR #2027).

    * Thanks to Ravindu Lakmina Munaweera (Github: @Ravi-lk) for
      reporting and fixing a DOS infinite-loop (CVE-2026-102253).

    * Thanks to Dirk Müller for finding and reporting an issue with
      test parameters (PR #2039, CVE-2026-71217).

    * The iperf-3.18 release notes were updated to reflect that a code
      change in that version addresses CVE-2026-71218.

* Notable user-visible changes

    * Attempting to set zero parallel streams is no longer allowed (PR
      #2048).

    * Zerocopy and rx-copy are now allowed in the case of reverse
      direction tests and the server (sending side) supports these
      features but the client (receiving side) does not (#2045,
      PR #2044).

    * The limit on GSO_MAX_DG_IN_BF was fixed to limit the number of segments
      to the maximum allowed (#2032 / PR #2033). This change unbreaks
      GSO for small message sizes.

* Notable developer-visible changes

    * In iperf_auth.c, in addition to fixing the heap buffer overflow, the
      return value of several functions is checked (PR #2046, PR #2040).

    * Several file descriptor leaks have been fixed (PR #2034).

    * In iperf_tcp, connections now timeout to prevent a race condition in
      accepting new connections to avoid a deadlock (#2029, PR #2030).

    * Periodic timers are now cancelled at the end of a test (#2018,
      PR #2021).

    * DSCP/TOS is now correctly set in the first UDP/TCP stream packet
      (#510, #830, PR #2047).

###### Linux

```sh
ETCD_VER=v3.7.3

# choose either URL
GOOGLE_URL=https://storage.googleapis.com/etcd
GITHUB_URL=https://github.com/etcd-io/etcd/releases/download

rm -rf /tmp/etcd-download-test && mkdir -p /tmp/etcd-download-test

curl -L ${DOWNLOAD_URL}/${ETCD_VER}/etcd-${ETCD_VER}-linux-amd64.tar.gz -o /tmp/etcd-${ETCD_VER}-linux-amd64.tar.gz
tar xzvf /tmp/etcd-${ETCD_VER}-linux-amd64.tar.gz -C /tmp/etcd-download-test --strip-components=1 --no-same-owner
rm -f /tmp/etcd-${ETCD_VER}-linux-amd64.tar.gz

/tmp/etcd-download-test/etcd --version
/tmp/etcd-download-test/etcdctl version
/tmp/etcd-download-test/etcdutl version

# start a local etcd server
/tmp/etcd-download-test/etcd

```

###### macOS (Darwin)

```sh
mv /tmp/etcd-${ETCD_VER}-darwin-amd64/* /tmp/etcd-download-test && rm -rf mv /tmp/etcd-${ETCD_VER}-darwin-amd64

/tmp/etcd-download-test/etcd --version
/tmp/etcd-download-test/etcdctl version
/tmp/etcd-download-test/etcdutl version
```

###### Docker

etcd uses [`gcr.io/etcd-development/etcd`](https://gcr.io/etcd-development/etcd) as a primary container registry, and [`quay.io/coreos/etcd`](https://quay.io/coreos/etcd) as secondary.

```sh
ETCD_VER=v3.7.3

rm -rf /tmp/etcd-data.tmp && mkdir -p /tmp/etcd-data.tmp && \
  docker rmi gcr.io/etcd-development/etcd:${ETCD_VER} || true && \
  docker run \
  -p 2379:2379 \
  -p 2380:2380 \
  --mount type=bind,source=/tmp/etcd-data.tmp,destination=/etcd-data \
  --name etcd-gcr-${ETCD_VER} \
  gcr.io/etcd-development/etcd:${ETCD_VER} \
  /usr/local/bin/etcd \
  --name s1 \
  --data-dir /etcd-data \
  --listen-client-urls http://0.0.0.0:2379 \
  --advertise-client-urls http://0.0.0.0:2379 \
  --listen-peer-urls http://0.0.0.0:2380 \
  --initial-advertise-peer-urls http://0.0.0.0:2380 \
  --initial-cluster s1=http://0.0.0.0:2380 \
  --initial-cluster-token tkn \
  --initial-cluster-state new \
  --log-level info \
  --logger zap \
  --log-outputs stderr

docker exec etcd-gcr-${ETCD_VER} /usr/local/bin/etcd --version
docker exec etcd-gcr-${ETCD_VER} /usr/local/bin/etcdctl version
docker exec etcd-gcr-${ETCD_VER} /usr/local/bin/etcdutl version
docker exec etcd-gcr-${ETCD_VER} /usr/local/bin/etcdctl endpoint health
docker exec etcd-gcr-${ETCD_VER} /usr/local/bin/etcdctl put foo bar
docker exec etcd-gcr-${ETCD_VER} /usr/local/bin/etcdctl get foo
```

# CC Switch v4.0.22

本版本新增对 DeepSeek Harness 的支持，它是 CC Switch 管理的第 14 个应用：供应商一起写进它的 Web 和 Desktop 配置，MCP、Skills、提示词同步给它，会话可以浏览，「应用」页可以安装、升级、卸载；还可以在授权中心登录 DeepSeek 账号、查看余额，用量也会统计。Oh My Pi 的用量现在也会统计。「打开终端」可以勾选跳过权限确认、追加启动参数，Codex 卡片也能打开终端；WebDAV 配置可以清除；Skills 可以打开目录、在发现页查看文档；GitHub Copilot 的 Claude 模型改走原生接口，提示缓存命中率大幅提高。另外修复了 macOS 上连了 OAuth 远程 MCP 时切换 Claude 账号失败、开了全局代理时添加 Claude 账号报 403、Claude Desktop 新会话默认用 Fable、MiniMax 周额度用完后不显示、没在用的供应商余额不自动刷新、请求被转回路由自己导致内存暴涨、Gemini 工具调用报 400、xAI 拒绝 Codex 0.163 的请求、请求日志里存下整页报错把数据库撑大等问题。4.0 完整的更新内容请见 [v4.0 发布说明](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.4-zh.md)。

**[English →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.22-en.md) | [日本語版 →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.22-ja.md)**

---

## 新增

### DeepSeek Harness

DeepSeek Harness（命令是 `dsh`）现在是一个独立的应用，有自己的供应商、MCP、Skills、提示词和会话（[#8795](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8795)、[#8986](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8986)）。配置在 `~/.dsh`，设了 `DSH_HOME` 时以它为准。

- **Web 和 Desktop 一起管理。** DeepSeek Harness 的网页版和桌面版各有一份配置（profile），CC Switch 把供应商和 MCP 同时写进两份，缺的那份会自动建好；已经初始化的 headless、acp 也一起写。侧栏只有一个 DeepSeek Harness，「已添加」标题旁注明 Web 和 Desktop 共用这份列表。某一份被手动改得和另一份不一样时，编辑会被拒绝并提示，不会覆盖你的改动。
- **供应商可以同时添加。** 和 OpenCode 一样是「添加」「移除」，多个供应商同时写进去，在 DeepSeek Harness 里选模型。支持 OpenAI Chat Completions、OpenAI Responses、Anthropic Messages 三种接口，预设来自 Pi 的目录。API Key 写进 DeepSeek Harness 自己的凭据文件 `.credentials.yaml`，配置里只放引用；配置里的其他插件设置原样保留，写入失败会回滚。
- **模型编辑。** 思考、图片输入用开关，上下文长度和最大输出单独填，和 Pi、Kimi Code 的模型行一样；DeepSeek Harness 还可以设置可选的思考档位和每个模型的接口兼容选项。OpenCode、MiniMax Code 的模型编辑也改成了这个样子。
- **DeepSeek 账号登录。** 在授权中心的 DeepSeek Harness 组用浏览器登录 DeepSeek 账号，显示余额和赠金；Web 和 Desktop 共用这份登录，在任一处登录或退出，两边同时生效。添加供应商时选「DeepSeek 官方登录」会跳到授权中心。登录后，账号以一张官方卡显示在「已添加」最前面，账号下的模型由 DeepSeek Harness 自己提供，这张卡不能编辑，退出登录后自动消失。
- **MCP、Skills、提示词。** 支持 stdio 和 Streamable HTTP 两种 MCP。
- **会话和用量。** 可以浏览 DeepSeek Harness 的会话（含思考过程和工具调用）；恢复和删除会话请在 DeepSeek Harness 里操作。用量从会话记录导入，走 DeepSeek 账号的请求在用量页单独显示为「DeepSeek 账号（OAuth）」。
- **「应用」页管理 DeepSeek Harness。** 用 npm 安装、升级、卸载 `@deepseek-ai/dsh`，卸载不删你的数据。
- DeepSeek Harness 不经过本地路由。

### Oh My Pi 的用量统计

用量页现在会统计 Oh My Pi 的用量，有自己的应用分类（[#9046](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9046)、[#8939](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8939)）。子代理的用量、对话之外的模型调用也会算进去，首次导入会包括以前的子代理会话。Oh My Pi 和 Pi 用同一个会话目录时，各自只导入自己的会话。Pi 已导入的数据不用重新导入。

### 「打开终端」可以跳过权限确认、追加启动参数

「打开终端」对话框多了两项（[#9008](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9008)）：

- **跳过权限确认。** 勾选后 Claude Code 和 Antigravity 以 `--dangerously-skip-permissions` 启动，Codex 以 `--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox` 启动。默认不勾。
- **附加参数（可选）。** 填 `--debug`、`--append-system-prompt "Be concise"` 这类参数，接在启动命令后面。用空格分隔，含空格的值用引号括起来，最多 16 个。参数只作为参数传给程序，不会被当成命令执行。

两项都只用于这次打开的终端，不写进任何配置；终端打开成功后，CC Switch 会按应用记住你的选择。

### Codex 卡片也能「打开终端」

以前 Codex 卡片上没有这个按钮。现在第三方卡片打开的终端只用这张卡：以 `codex -c ...` 启动，不改 `config.toml`，Key 通过环境变量传入，不出现在命令行里。当前供应商在 `config.toml` 里留下的设置会尽量改成不影响这张卡的值，改不了的（比如请求头、指定的 profile）会提示先切到这张卡再打开，避免当前供应商的 Key 被发到别处。当前使用中的卡直接启动 `codex`。

### 清除 WebDAV 配置

以前配好 WebDAV 同步后，只能关掉自动同步，地址、账号、密码一直留在本机（[#8977](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8977)）。现在 WebDAV 同步设置里有「清除配置」按钮，确认后从本机删除这些信息并停止自动同步；云端已上传的数据不会删除。

### Skills：打开目录、复制名称、查看文档

- **已安装的 Skill**（[#8993](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8993)）：⋯ 菜单里可以「打开目录」，在文件管理器里打开这个 Skill 的文件夹；点击 Skill 名称就能复制名称。原来的「复制目录名」去掉了。
- **发现页**（[#9039](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9039)）：每一行多了「打开文档」按钮，安装前可以先看说明，没有文档时打开仓库主页。

## 改进

**GitHub Copilot 的 Claude 模型提示缓存命中率大幅提高**（[#8908](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8908)）。以前 Copilot 的 Claude 模型一律转成 Chat Completions 格式发送，会丢掉缓存标记，Claude Code 在对话中途插入的系统消息还会打断缓存。现在 Copilot 支持原生 Anthropic 接口的模型直接走原生接口，Copilot 企业版长会话的缓存命中率实测从约 35% 提高到约 95%。

**添加、启用、停用、删除 Skill 仓库时，只重新读取这一个仓库**（[#8907](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8907)、[#1426](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/1426)），不再把所有仓库重新下载一遍。点刷新按钮仍会全部重新读取。

**托盘和用量设置里也能看到绑了账号的 Claude 官方卡额度。** 以前只有卡片上显示，托盘里没有，用量设置弹窗还显示成未启用。

**Claude Desktop 的路由服务也接受 `x-api-key` 传令牌**（[#5123](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/5123)），令牌校验改成固定耗时的比较（[#7488](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/7488)、[#7482](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/7482)）。

**Claude 配置目录在 WSL 里时，授权中心直接说明暂不支持 Claude 账号**，「添加账号」「重新登录」不可用。以前会让你改用「打开终端」，但这时打开的是 Windows 里的 Claude Code，同样用不了。

**MCP、Skills 列表悬停勾选框时不再同时弹出两个提示**；问号帮助卡片改为显示在右边，不再挡住鼠标，长内容会换行、在卡片里滚动（[#8593](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8593)）。

**从别处跳到授权中心的某一组时，页面其他部分不再跟着移动**（[#8964](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8964)）。

**OpenCode、OpenClaw、Hermes 的配置文件读不了时，供应商页会显示错误**（[#9044](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9044)）。以前页面像从没配置过一样空着，添加供应商失败后才看到报错，还会留下一条多余的记录。

**托管的 ChatGPT、xAI 账号登录过期时，提示改为「请在授权中心重新登录这个账号」。** 以前提示运行一条并不存在的命令。

**预设：** 新增 OspreyAI、讯飞星火 Astron Coding Plan 的 Claude Code 预设（[#9036](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9036)）；TokenFlux 改用新域名 tokenflux.com，tokenflux.dev 作为备用地址。

## 修复

- **macOS 上连了需要 OAuth 登录的远程 MCP 时，切换 Claude 账号报「Claude Code 的登录信息太大，无法写入钥匙串，没有切换」**（[#9002](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9002)）。MCP 的登录信息和账号存在同一个钥匙串条目里，超过了一次写入的长度上限。现在超长时改用和 Claude Code 一样的写法。
- **开了全局代理时，在授权中心添加 Claude 账号，浏览器登录成功后报 403**（[#9038](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9038)）。换取令牌是 Claude Code 自己完成的，以前它没有用到全局代理。现在 CC Switch 运行 Claude Code 登录、查额度时会把全局代理传给它（SOCKS 代理 Claude Code 不支持，不传）。
- **Claude Desktop 新会话默认用 Fable，而且模型顺序每次启用配置都会变**（[#7491](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/7491)、[#7457](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/7457)、[#8973](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8973)）。Claude Desktop 把模型列表里的第一个当默认模型，以前按字母顺序写。现在按界面上 Sonnet、Opus、Fable、Haiku 的顺序写，新会话默认用 Sonnet 档。
- **MiniMax 周额度用完后，卡片和托盘里不再显示周额度，5 小时额度刚重置时看起来像额度全满**（[#8124](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8124)、[#8123](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8123)）。现在显示为红色的「已用完」和周额度重置倒计时。
- **没在用的供应商设了自动查询间隔，余额也不刷新**（[#8342](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8342)、[#8335](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8335)）。
- **上游地址填成了路由自己的地址时，请求被无限转回路由，内存不断增长**（[#8598](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8598)）。现在直接报配置错误。
- **Claude Code 经路由连 Gemini 时，工具调用后报 400**：签名放错位置报「Unknown name thoughtSignature」（[#6690](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/6690)）；CC Switch 重启后或较早的轮次丢了签名，Gemini 3 以上拒绝请求（[#6833](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/6833)）；Vertex 上工具结果后面跟着文字时报「Requests ending with a model turn are not supported」（[#8988](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8988)）。
- **Claude Code 经路由转 OpenAI Responses 时，WebSearch 带屏蔽域名就直接报 400**（[#8979](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8979)）。现在 API Key 接入的 Responses 上游会原样传过去；ChatGPT 官方登录的路由不支持屏蔽域名，仍会明确报错。
- **Codex 0.163 以上经路由连 xAI 时报 400**（[#8997](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8997)、[#8996](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8996)）。
- **Codex 的 `config.toml` 里有 `[[skills.config]]` 这类数组表时，第三方供应商的地址被写进了这张表里**（[#9029](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9029)、[#9023](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9023)）。
- **OpenCode 新格式（V2）的供应商「检测连通」报缺少 `options.baseURL`**（[#8969](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8969)）。
- **上游报错时，请求日志存下整页 HTML 报错，数据库和备份越来越大**（[#9010](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9010)、[#6706](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/6706)）。现在每条只存前 4096 个字符；已经存下的旧记录这次不清理。
- **Windows 上用 MyDockFinder 这类第三方任务栏时，点托盘图标没反应**（[#8729](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8729)、[#8565](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8565)）。
- **Kimi Code 0.43.0 以前的版本在「应用」页升级后版本不变**（[#9032](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9032)）。旧版本没有自动确认升级的选项，现在改用安装它的包管理器，或重新运行官方安装脚本。
- **「应用」页里，程序文件在但运行不起来的应用，分在「已安装」组里却显示「未安装」。** 现在显示为「无法运行」，并给出原因。
- **Antigravity 的 CLI 和 IDE 都装了时，在 IDE 里继续的旧会话用量不更新、会话打不开**（[#8941](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8941)）。

## 升级说明

**数据库版本从 23 升到 24**，为 MCP 和 Skills 增加 DeepSeek Harness 的开关。升级前会自动备份数据库；升级后再退回旧版本，旧版本会提示数据库版本过新，打不开。

- DeepSeek Harness 默认显示在侧栏，不用的话可以在「应用」页关掉「在侧栏显示 DeepSeek Harness」。

fastfetch-cli/fastfetch:
Changes: * LocalIP flags on Windows now describe the interface itself — its operational status, its media connection state and its type, for example `ETHERNET_CSMACD`, `IEEE80211` or `SOFTWARE_LOOPBACK` — instead of the `IP_ADAPTER_*` bits. * Interfaces that carry no unicast address are no longer reported, since both the addresses and the interface properties are now enumerated from the unicast address table. (LocalIP, Windows) * libpulse and libddcutil are no longer used on Linux. Package managers should remove them from their fastfetch package. * QuickJS format scripting has been removed (deprecated in v2.69.0). Migrate scripts to Lua if necessary. (General) * The Command module option `useStdErr` has been replaced with `useOutput`, which selects which of the command's output streams to capture: `"stdout"`, `"stderr"` or `"both"`. * It defaults to `"both"`, so a command that logs to stderr now has that output captured instead of discarded. * Set it to `"stdout"` or `"stderr"` to restore the old single-stream behavior. (Command) * The Shell module now reports the shell from the password database (`/etc/passwd`) instead of the `$SHELL` environment variable, which may differ when the login shell was changed after the session started. (Title) * The Disk custom format no longer provides `{size-available}`. `{size-free}` now reports whichever of the two the `disk.useAvailable` option selects, and the raw byte counts are available as `{bytes-used}` and `{bytes-total}`. (Disk) * This also means `{size-free}` now changes with `disk.useAvailable`; it used to always report the file system's free size. * The Disk JSON output no longer includes `bytes.available` and `bytes.used`. (Disk) * `bytes.free` and `bytes.total` are unchanged; the used size can be derived as `total - free`. Features: * Added Sound detection on Android. (Sound, Android) * Added display detection on Android over binder, which needs neither a child process nor a permission. (Display, Android) * Added battery temperature, remaining time and charger type (AC / USB / wireless) detection on Android. (Battery, Android) * Added media detection on Android when fastfetch runs as an app UID. (Media, Android) * Requires `Notification access` permission * Added app display-name detection on Android, so the media module names the player the way the app names itself instead of by its package name, and the terminal module reports the label Termux is installed under. (Media, Terminal, Android) * Performance improvements & internal cleanups * Added Finnish language support. (General) * Added pkgsrc package detection on macOS. (#2627, Packages, Apple) * Added an ALSA fallback to Sound on Linux, so a machine that runs no sound server reports its output device and volume instead of an error. (Sound, Linux) Bugfixes: * Fixed `--config`/`-c` bash completion offering one candidate per word instead of one candidate per file for paths containing spaces. (Completion, Bash) * Fixed external monitors detected via DDC/CI being randomly reported as built-in on Linux. (#2615, Brightness, Linux) * Fixed the Vulkan driver name being concatenated with the name of a previously enumerated device on multi-GPU systems. (#2619, Vulkan) * Fixed the foot terminal font size not being parsed when written as `Font Name-size`, e.g. `Berkeley Mono-12`. (#2624, TerminalFont, Linux) * Fixed `/boot` being hidden by default on Haiku, where it is the system volume. (Disk, Haiku) * Improved Snapdragon X1/X2 model name detection on Linux. (#2625, CPU, Linux) * Fixed the Android build failing with `GL/gl.h` not found, because the NDK ships the EGL headers that turned OpenGL detection on but not the desktop GL headers it includes. (OpenGL, Android) * Fixed MAC address reporting `02:00:00:00:00:00` on macOS 27. (LocalIP, Apple) * Fixed assertion failure when percentage exceeds 100. (Percent) * Fixed a non-existent command being reported as a generic child process error on Windows instead of `command not found`. (Command, Windows) * Fixed Android display detection on devices running Android 17. (Display, Android) * Fixed Windows volumes with a per-user quota (such as network shares) reporting a wrong total size and a wrapped-around used size, because the total size was quota-limited while the free size was not. (#2651, Disk, Windows) * On Windows 10 1809 (build 17763) and later, the whole volume's capacity and free space are now reported by default. Set `disk.useAvailable` to `true` to keep reporting the space that is available to the current user, quota included. Logos: * Added filled Artix logo (#2631) * Renamed PostmarketOS to nura (#2626) ---

fatedier/frp:
## Improvements

* Building frp from source now requires Go 1.26.0 or later.

## Fixes

* Updated dependencies to fix SSH tunnel gateway channel deadlocks and panics caused by malformed challenges from NTLM-authenticated HTTP proxies.
* Fixed VirtualNet routing issues during reconnection and shutdown, and excessive retries after repeated connection failures.
* Health checks now reset the failure count after success, so `healthCheck.maxFailed` applies to consecutive failures.
* Fixed control connections getting stuck after message write failures, which could block reconnection.
* Fixed incorrect daily traffic statistics around daylight-saving transitions and skipped local midnights.
* Fixed early-data loss in HTTP virtual-host CONNECT tunnels. Requests with a positive content length or transfer encoding now return HTTP 400.
* Fixed work connections remaining open when server-side bandwidth limiting is enabled for TCP, HTTP, and UDP proxies.
felixrieseberg/windows95:
Fixes a race in v5.0.0 where the packaged app could cold-boot instead of resuming from saved state — on a cold launch (Gatekeeper scan, cold disk cache) v86 hadn't finished loading the wasm/BIOS/disk before `restore_state()` ran, the restore silently failed, and the VM started fresh. Now waits for v86's `emulator-loaded` event. (#367)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/felixrieseberg/windows95/compare/v5.0.0...v5.0.1

firecracker-microvm/firecracker:
## Added

* [#5891](https://github.com/firecracker-microvm/firecracker/pull/5891): Added support for virtio device reset.
* [#5983](https://github.com/firecracker-microvm/firecracker/pull/5983): Add two optional metrics fields, set via `PUT /metrics` or a config file: `emit_id` emits the microVM instance id under a top-level `id` field, and `properties` emits operator-defined key-value pairs under a top-level `properties` field. Each is opt-in and independent. See [metrics documentation](docs/metrics.md).
* [#6003](https://github.com/firecracker-microvm/firecracker/pull/6003): Added a new option `Transparent` for the `huge_pages` setting. If set, Firecracker will use transparent huge pages for the guest memory via `madvise(MADV_HUGEPAGE)`. Guest memory must be a multiple of 2MB when using this option.
* [#6013](https://github.com/firecracker-microvm/firecracker/pull/6013), [#6017](https://github.com/firecracker-microvm/firecracker/pull/6017), [#6021](https://github.com/firecracker-microvm/firecracker/pull/6021): Added official support for 6.18 microVM guest kernels.
* [#6037](https://github.com/firecracker-microvm/firecracker/pull/6037): Added support for booting `bzImage` guest kernels on x86_64, in addition to the existing uncompressed ELF (`vmlinux`) images. The kernel image format is detected automatically, so no configuration change is required.
* [#6064](https://github.com/firecracker-microvm/firecracker/pull/6064): Added the `huge_pages` field to `PUT /snapshot/load`, allowing the restored microVM to reuse the snapshot's host page configuration or select `None`, `Transparent`, or `2M`.
* [#6109](https://github.com/firecracker-microvm/firecracker/pull/6109): Added an optional `sync_snapshot_files` field to the `PUT /snapshot/create` API, defaulting to `true`. It controls whether the snapshot state and guest memory files are synced to disk (`fsync`) before the request returns. Setting it to `false` returns without waiting for the writeback, making snapshot creation faster at the cost of durability across a host crash; the data stays in the host page cache, so same-host reads still see the full contents. Block device backing files are always `fsync`'d regardless. See [snapshot documentation](docs/snapshotting/snapshot-support.md).
* [#6116](https://github.com/firecracker-microvm/firecracker/pull/6116): On aarch64, enable `KVM_CAP_ARM_WRITABLE_IMP_ID_REGS` when the host kernel offers it (Linux 6.15 and later), adding support for custom CPU templates that modify the implementation ID registers (`MIDR_EL1`, `REVIDR_EL1`, `AIDR_EL1`). Such templates previously failed at boot with `Failed to set register ... Invalid argument` because KVM rejects the write unless the capability is enabled on the VM.
* [#6145](https://github.com/firecracker-microvm/firecracker/pull/6145): Added official support for AWS Graviton5 (m9g.metal-48xl) instances.
* [#6098](https://github.com/firecracker-microvm/firecracker/pull/6098): Added new VIRTIO_BLK_F_BLK_SIZE and VIRTIO_BLK_F_TOPOLOGY features to the virtio-block device. More information is in the new [block](docs/block.md) documentation.
* [#6142](https://github.com/firecracker-microvm/firecracker/pull/6142): Add opt-in virtio-blk discard support for writable `Sync` IO engine drives through the `discard` drive configuration field. See the [block discard documentation](docs/api_requests/block-discard.md).

## Changed

* [#6115](https://github.com/firecracker-microvm/firecracker/pull/6115): Changed the T2S CPU template to set the `FB_CLEAR` bit of `MSR_IA32_ARCH_CAPABILITIES` to 1. This lets guest kernels recognize that the `VERW` instruction clears fill buffers, including on host kernels before v6.4 that cannot expose `FLUSH_L1D`.
* [#6172](https://github.com/firecracker-microvm/firecracker/pull/6172): Gate CLIRD_EL1 override to only happen on host kernels equal or newer than 6.10 release. This aliviates the guest performance regression seen on host kernels in range \[6.3..6.10) correlated to incorrect cpu cache topology presented to the guest.

## Fixed

* [#6100](https://github.com/firecracker-microvm/firecracker/pull/6100): Fixed the vsock device permanently suppressing RX (host-to-guest) delivery after a bare pause/resume cycle (`PATCH /vm` with `Paused` then `Resumed`, without a snapshot). The resume kick armed the `TRANSPORT_RESET` RX gate even though no reset event had been sent, so the guest could never acknowledge it and every new host-initiated connection made after the resume hung forever. The gate is now part of the persisted device state and the resume kick respects it instead of arming it.
* [#6174](https://github.com/firecracker-microvm/firecracker/pull/6174): Fixed `virtio-mem` leaving unplugged memory writable by the VMM, and potentially unmapped, on microVMs restored from a snapshot memory file. Firecracker now maps each slot straight to the protection it should have, with the `MAP_NORESERVE` flag, and aborts if the re-map fails.
* [#6174](https://github.com/firecracker-microvm/firecracker/pull/6174): Fixed `virtio-mem` discarding the whole hotpluggable region on every `UNPLUG_ALL` request, even when nothing was plugged. The discard is now skipped when the range has no plugged blocks.
* [#6176](https://github.com/firecracker-microvm/firecracker/pull/6176): Fixed `virtio-mem` leaving its block accounting inconsistent with the KVM memory slots if a plug or unplug request failed part way through. Firecracker now commits each slot's state only after its KVM update succeeds, so a partial failure leaves the block state and the KVM slots reflecting exactly the slots that were updated.
* [#5956](https://github.com/firecracker-microvm/firecracker/pull/5956): Fixed a TOCTOU race in the aarch64 jailer when setting ownership of the CPU cache and `MIDR_EL1` information files copied into the chroot.
* [#6076](https://github.com/firecracker-microvm/firecracker/pull/6076): Fixed memory hotplug sizes silently wrapping when converted from MiB to bytes. `requested_size_mib` on `PATCH /hotplug/memory` and `total_size_mib`, `block_size_mib` and `slot_size_mib` on `PUT /hotplug/memory` are now bounded to 32 bits. Values above that previously wrapped to a smaller byte count, so a large enough request was accepted as a 0-byte region instead of being rejected.
* [#6031](https://github.com/firecracker-microvm/firecracker/pull/6031), [#6041](https://github.com/firecracker-microvm/firecracker/pull/6041), [#6077](https://github.com/firecracker-microvm/firecracker/pull/6077): Fixed the vsock device re-arming its host-stream `EPOLLIN` interest while received data was still awaiting a guest RX buffer, which could busy-spin the event thread until the guest posted buffers. The device now drains the host stream fully across successive RX operations instead of one packet per event loop iteration, reducing the host-side CPU cost per gigabit of host-to-guest traffic by up to ~50% and improving host-to-guest throughput by ~44% (median) in most configurations. On single-vcpu microVMs on the newest Intel hosts (m7i, m8i), host-to-guest throughput may instead decrease by ~15% (median), where the single guest vCPU rather than the host becomes the bottleneck. Terminating a connection now also discards its TX buffer, so the device stops advertising `EPOLLOUT` for a host stream it will never write to again, which could otherwise busy-spin the event thread indefinitely.
* [#6086](https://github.com/firecracker-microvm/firecracker/pull/6086), [#6143](https://github.com/firecracker-microvm/firecracker/pull/6143): Fixed a deadlock in the logger: a signal handler that logs while the interrupted thread is already logging would hang the VMM and its API socket. This is reachable whenever a `SIGPIPE` is raised by Firecracker's own log write, for example when logging to `stdout` and the reader of that pipe exits. The logger now uses an `RwLock`, and `sigpipe_handler` only increments the `signals.sigpipe` metric instead of logging, so it no longer emits a `Received signal 13, code 0.` line.
* [#6120](https://github.com/firecracker-microvm/firecracker/pull/6120): Fixed a bug caused by a KVM behavior change introduced in Linux 6.13, which requires guest CPUID to be set before userspace reads CPUID-dependent MSRs. On x86_64 with Linux 6.18 host kernels, Firecracker read the base values of those MSRs before setting guest CPUID, so KVM returned zero for such MSRs and CPU templates consequently used zero for bits configured for passthrough. Firecracker now sets guest CPUID before reading MSRs to be modified by CPU templates, so passthrough bits retain their KVM-provided values and features such as eIBRS remain exposed to the guest.
firecrawl/anydoc:
## Scanned pages are reported, not dropped

A PDF with scanned or image-only pages used to convert with those pages silently missing, and a fully scanned one failed as unsupported. Conversion now fails naming the pages: `ConvertError::NeedsOcr { pages, page_count }` in Rust, `needsOcr` with `pages` and `pageCount` on the error in Node and wasm, `NeedsOcrError` with `.pages` and `.page_count` in Python, exit code 3 on the CLI.

```
$ anydoc scan.pdf
anydoc: pages 2, 5-7 of 12 need OCR
```

## Hosted OCR, opt in

anydoc converts locally and does not do OCR. In Node and Python, `ocr: 'hosted'` / `ocr="hosted"` (CLI: `--ocr hosted`) sends a PDF that fails with `needsOcr`, and only that, to [Firecrawl Parse](https://firecrawl.dev/parse). It works without an account, and setting `FIRECRAWL_API_KEY` raises the limits. Failures come back as `hosted` / `HostedError`. No new dependencies.

```js
const markdown = await toMarkdown('scan.pdf', { ocr: 'hosted' });
```

## Node package

The entry point is now `anydoc.js`, a wrapper over the generated binding. Everything `index.js` exported is still exported.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/firecrawl/anydoc/compare/v0.2.3...v0.2.4
